* - Top-of-funnel short-form edits: hook-driven videos including clone-style edits (cutting between multiple takes of the same person — different outfits or props — to create a back-and-forth two-persona effect) and animation-heavy comparison/pop-up style videos



* - Middle-of-funnel call clips: given a raw call recording and its transcript, find a strong hook moment and cut it into a clean, captioned short-form clip



* - UGC-style editing for personal brand content



* - Self-QC on every edit before submitting: catching caption typos, spelling errors, and basic animation mistakes before they ever reach review



* - Working inside a daily upload pipeline alongside a scriptwriter, social media manager, and personal assistant





You Are a Fit If:



* - You've edited clone-style videos before (cutting between multiple takes of the same person to create a two-persona effect) — this is not something you're learning on the job



* - You've done UGC-style editing before, for a real client or personal brand



* - You understand retention, hooks, and why a video keeps someone watching past the first 2 seconds



* - You've helped grow someone's personal brand or social media before, working closely with the founder/creator themselves



* - You catch your own mistakes — typos, missing captions, bad animation — before anyone else has to





Do Not Apply If



* - you have never edited a clone-style video (cutting between multiple takes of the same person for a two-persona effect)

* - you have never done UGC-style editing

* - you can't commit to fitting into a daily upload schedule and staying responsive in a team group chat

title: Social Media Assistant (Reddit) - Part-Time, Per-Task
description:
About the role



We are looking for active Reddit users to join our team as part-time, task-based Reddit Community Contributors.

This is a good fit for someone who already spends time on Reddit, understands how different communities work, and enjoys participating in discussions.



You do not need to be a professional marketer or content writer. We’re primarily looking for people who already have genuine Reddit experience and can navigate the platform naturally and responsibly.



What you’ll do:



Depending on the project, tasks may include:



-Publish approved posts and comments on industry-relevant subreddits from the content we supply

-Reply to follow-up comments in a helpful, respectful, human way, using our guidelines and prompts

-Flag subreddit rule changes, mod feedback, or removed posts to our team

-Report each task in a shared tracker



You will not be expected to create marketing content from scratch. Our team will provide the content, information, and general instructions needed for each assignment, along with each community’s rules and our guidelines on how to follow them, including any disclosure requirements.



What we’re looking for



We’re especially interested in people who:



-Are active Reddit users

-Have an established Reddit account, ideally 2+ years old

-Have meaningful karma and a genuine history of participation

-Regularly post or comment on Reddit

-Understand Reddit culture and subreddit-specific rules

-Have strong written English

-Can recognize when content is appropriate for a particular community

-Are reliable and able to complete tasks on time



Experience participating in communities related to law, healthcare, business, marketing, or other professional topics is a plus.



Availability



This is a remote, task-based position rather than a fixed full-time schedule. You do not need to be online at specific hours every day, but you should generally be available during at least part of the morning or afternoon Central Time (CT) when assignments require posting or responding.



Compensation



Paid per task, typically $2 to $5+ per task depending on the type and scope of the assignment (for example, comments and posts are paid at different rates). Quality bonuses are available for work that follows our guidelines and stays live. 



To apply



Send your application through this platform and we’ll contact you with a link to a short application form to complete the next step. Please make sure the Reddit account you provide is your own established account and represents your normal Reddit activity. We’re particularly interested in people who genuinely enjoy Reddit and understand how to participate in different communities appropriately.

title: Video Editor — Edit for a Growing Fitness Creator's Page (Clone Edits, UGC & Call Clips)
description:
About Us:



You'd be editing 
 — a fitness coaching page that's actively growing and posting daily, not a one-off freelance gig. ZM Consulting runs the content, sales systems, and automation behind the page. Every edit you ship goes straight into a live daily pipeline, so your portfolio grows alongside a real, active creator instead of sitting on a shelf.





Compensation:



Paid per video ($5-$12 depending on complexity), 45-60 videos a month, landing around $450-$600/month total. The pipeline runs every day, so the work is steady — it doesn't dry up between projects like typical freelance editing does.





Schedule and Availability:



No fixed hours or timezone requirement. What matters is that you consistently fit into a daily upload pipeline — videos need to keep moving so the schedule never breaks. You'll be in a group chat with the full content team (scriptwriter, social media manager, personal assistant) and need to actively communicate with them, not work in isolation.





What You Will Own:



* - Top-of-funnel short-form edits: hook-driven videos including clone-style edits (cutting between multiple takes of the same person — different outfits or props — to create a back-and-forth two-persona effect) and animation-heavy comparison/pop-up style videos



* - Middle-of-funnel call clips: given a raw call recording and its transcript, find a strong hook moment and cut it into a clean, captioned short-form clip



* - UGC-style editing for personal brand content



* - Self-QC on every edit before submitting: catching caption typos, spelling errors, and basic animation mistakes before they ever reach review



* - Working inside a daily upload pipeline alongside a scriptwriter, social media manager, and personal assistant





You Are a Fit If:

* - You want your portfolio built on a real, growing personal brand you can point to — not just scattered one-off client work

* - You've edited clone-style videos before (cutting between multiple takes of the same person to create a two-persona effect) — this is not something you're learning on the job

* - You've done UGC-style editing before, for a real client or personal brand

* - You understand retention, hooks, and why a video keeps someone watching past the first 2 seconds

* - You catch your own mistakes — typos, missing captions, bad animation — before anyone else has to





Do Not Apply If



* - you have never edited a clone-style video (cutting between multiple takes of the same person for a two-persona effect)

* - you have never done UGC-style editing

* - you can't commit to fitting into a daily upload schedule and staying responsive in a team group chat

* - you're applying without a portfolio link and a Loom intro video — applications without both will not be considered

* - you have not watched all 5 example videos below — applications that don't reference them will not be considered

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer / Technical Owner - React, TypeScript, Supabase
description:
MIARI is a live SaaS platform for influencer marketing. We are hiring one hands-on senior full-stack developer to take long-term technical ownership of our website and application.



COMPENSATION AND HOURS

USD $600 per month, full-time, 40 hours per week. Please apply only if this budget works for you. We need 3-4 hours of daily overlap with Israel time (Asia/Jerusalem; UTC+2 or UTC+3 depending on daylight saving).



THE WORK

You will inherit an existing React/TypeScript application built with Lovable, managed through GitHub, with Supabase/PostgreSQL on the backend. It has technical debt and recurring production issues. The priority is to understand the system, stabilize critical flows, fix root causes, and make changes safely while supporting ongoing business requests.



We need a developer who can independently read, write, debug, review and explain code. Experience prompting AI tools alone is not sufficient. AI coding tools are welcome, but you must verify their output and personally own correctness, security and maintainability.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own frontend, backend, database, integrations and deployment troubleshooting end to end.

- Diagnose production bugs using reproducible cases, browser/network tools, logs and SQL; document root causes and prevent regressions.

- Refactor large React components and duplicated backend logic incrementally without breaking live customer workflows.

- Work confidently in GitHub: branches, focused pull requests, code review, merge conflicts, checks, releases and rollback.

- Maintain Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL schemas, migrations, Row Level Security (RLS), Edge Functions and webhooks.

- Understand Lovable-generated code and the Lovable/GitHub workflow; safely improve the code directly when necessary.

- Add meaningful tests for critical flows, including payments, contracts, permissions and integrations.

- Prioritize issues, communicate realistic estimates, flag blockers early, and send concise daily updates with completed work, evidence and next steps.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- Strong hands-on React, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL and PostgreSQL skills in production systems.

- Practical Supabase experience, including authorization/RLS and safe database changes.

- Evidence of taking over an existing codebase, fixing difficult bugs and improving reliability.

- Strong Git/GitHub skills and ability to explain architectural decisions and trade-offs.

- Clear written English, dependable availability and independent execution.

- Familiarity with Lovable, or the ability to quickly understand its workflow while demonstrating strong underlying engineering skills.



HOW TO APPLY -
 ONLY

Send your application to 
 MIARI SENIOR - REFACTOR - Your Name

All screening and interview coordination will be by
. Do not contact us on WhatsApp.



Include your CV, GitHub/portfolio links, earliest start date, availability in Israel time, and answers to ALL questions below. Use specific examples from your own work. Do not disclose a previous employer's confidential code or credentials.



SCREENING QUESTIONS

1. Confirm that USD $600/month for 40 hours/week works for you. State your available hours and current work commitments.

2. Describe a production system you personally maintained: stack, your exact responsibilities, and one relevant code sample or pull request you are allowed to share. If private, provide a sanitized sample and explain it.

3. Describe a difficult production bug you solved: symptoms, investigation, root cause, code/database change, and how you verified the fix.

4. How would you safely split a 4,300-line React component while feature work continues? Explain testing, PR size and rollback.

5. A logged-in user can access another customer's records in Supabase. Where would you investigate, how would you contain the problem, and how would you test the authorization fix?

6. A payment webhook may be delivered twice or concurrently. How would you prevent duplicate processing at the database level and handle retries safely?

7. A Lovable change conflicts with work in GitHub. Explain how you would inspect, resolve, test and deploy the result without losing valid changes.

8. What would you inspect in your first week before making large changes? Explain how you prioritize i
, technical debt and feature requests.



SELECTION PROCESS

 application and technical questionnaire -> shortlisted candidates complete a paid technical exercise -> code review and live technical interview -> final decision.



The exercise is 3-5 hours, paid USD $50, as in our existing hiring process. It uses an isolated sample project with fictional data, never our live system. It focuses on React/TypeScript debugging, Supabase authorization, safe webhook processing, tests and a clear GitHub-style change explanation. We will agree the scope and timing by
 before you begin. You must disclose AI/tool assistance and be able to explain and modify your solution live.



We assess code quality, debugging depth, security, test evidence, system understanding and reliable communication. Our goal is to invite the two strongest candidates to interviews after reviewing their questionnaire and exercise. This is a long-term role for someone who takes real ownership of the system.

title: Head of Growth- Sales
description:
WE'RE HIRING: Head of Growth & Revenue



Senior E-Commerce & CPG Growth Strategist | Full-Time | Remote | Philippines or Latin America



About The Patch Method™



The Patch Method™ is a fast-growing, female-founded wearable wellness brand on a mission to make everyday wellness simpler, smarter, and more accessible through innovative vitamin patches. We're expanding across direct-to-consumer e-commerce, Amazon, retail, and strategic partnerships while launching products that bring a fresh perspective to the wellness industry. We're building a category-defining consumer brand, and we're looking for exceptional people who want to help build what comes next.



The Role



We're looking for a commercially minded, data-driven Head of Growth & Revenue to take ownership of sales growth across The Patch Method.



This is not a social media manager, a paid ads specialist, or someone who simply suggests marketing ideas. We need a growth leader who understands how successful CPG and DTC brands scale, can identify the greatest revenue opportunities, and knows how to turn strategy into measurable results through a team of specialists.



You will be responsible for developing and driving our company-wide revenue growth strategy across DTC, Amazon, wholesale, retail, affiliates, and new product launches.



You'll work directly with the Founder & CEO to define revenue goals, prioritize growth initiatives, coordinate marketing execution, and continuously improve customer acquisition, conversion, retention, and overall customer lifetime value.



You won't be expected to personally execute every ad campaign,
, or creative asset. You will be expected to know what needs to happen, why it matters, who should own it, and whether it is working.



Success in your first 90 days means:



A clear company-wide revenue dashboard and weekly growth reporting system are established.



A channel-by-channel revenue growth plan is developed, with priorities and measurable goals.



Customer acquisition, conversion, retention, and product performance have been analyzed to identify the biggest opportunities.



A 90-day growth roadmap is actively being executed across relevant sales channels.



Growth initiatives are being tested, measured, and optimized based on revenue, customer economics, and contribution margin.



Core Responsibilities



Own the company-wide sales growth strategy. Build and lead measurable revenue plans across Shopify DTC, Amazon, wholesale, retail, affiliate partnerships, and new product launches.



Lead customer acquisition strategy. Evaluate Meta, Google, TikTok, creator partnerships, affiliates, organic traffic, and other acquisition opportunities, identifying where investment can generate profitable growth.



Drive customer retention and lifetime value. Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases, subscription adoption, replenishment, customer loyalty, and revenue from existing customers.



Improve e-commerce conversion. Analyze Shopify conversion rates, landing pages, product pages, checkout performance, upsells, bundles, average order value, and customer experience.



Develop product and merchandising growth strategies. Use sales data, customer behavior, product performance, and market insights to recommend product positioning, bundles, promotional strategies, and revenue opportunities.



Lead product launch revenue planning. Build commercial launch strategies, forecasts, campaign plans, channel priorities, and performance measurement for new SKUs.



Coordinate growth specialists and partners. Direct the strategic priorities of paid media,
/SMS, creative, affiliate, and other marketing contributors without personally needing to execute every function.



Own growth analytics and forecasting. Establish dashboards and track total revenue, channel revenue, CAC, MER, ROAS, conversion rate, AOV, LTV, repeat purchase rate, and contribution margin.



Identify sales channel expansion opportunities. Evaluate growth potential across marketplaces, wholesale accounts, strategic partnerships, creator commerce, and emerging distribution channels, working with the founder on high-value opportunities.



Run weekly revenue reviews and experiments. Present performance against targets, diagnose gaps, recommend action, prioritize tests, and ensure learnings translate into improved execution.



Required Qualifications



6+ years in e-commerce, growth marketing, revenue strategy, or commercial growth roles, including meaningful ownership of growth outcomes.



Proven experience scaling a physical consumer product brand, ideally in CPG, wellness, beauty, supplements, or lifestyle.



Strong knowledge of Shopify and the DTC customer journey.



Demonstrated success increasing revenue while monitoring acquisition costs, profitability, and retention.



Solid working knowledge of Meta Ads, Google Ads, Klaviyo,
/SMS, affiliate marketing, and conversion rate optimization.



Ability to interpret marketing performance reports and build actionable growth strategies from data.



Experience planning and executing product launch strategies.



Experience leading or coordinating external specialists, agencies, or internal marketing teams.



Strong financial and analytical skills, including familiarity with gross margin, contribution margin, CAC, and customer lifetime value.



Excellent English communication skills and ability to confidently present strategic recommendations to the founder.



Experience building forecasts, performance dashboards, and structured growth roadmaps.



Non-negotiable: You must be able to provide concrete examples of sales growth you personally helped lead, including starting revenue, ending revenue, timeframe, major actions taken, and how profitability was considered.



Bonus Qualifications



Experience growing consumer brands from approximately $1M to $5M+ in annual revenue.



Experience with Amazon marketplace growth, wholesale, and omnichannel CPG strategies.



Experience scaling subscription or replenishment-based products.



Familiarity with Shopify analytics, GA4, Klaviyo, TikTok Shop, Faire, and attribution/reporting tools.



Experience with Amazon, specialty retail, or creator-driven commerce.



Understanding of inventory planning, product launch economics, and the impact of promotions on margins.



Experience using AI tools for growth research, analytics, experimentation, or workflow efficiency.



What Dedicated Means



This is a full-time, long-term, exclusive position working 40 hours per week for The Patch Method. We are not hiring a freelance consultant, fractional growth advisor, or agency strategist. You will be an embedded member of our leadership team, exclusively focused on growing our brand. We require 4–5 working hours of daily overlap with Arizona Mountain Standard Time (UTC−7 year-round), with flexibility for remaining working hours. You must be available for weekly revenue meetings, cross-functional planning, and regular collaboration with the founder.

title: Personal Assisant/ Brand Manager / AI Builder
description:
# WE'RE HIRING: Personal Brand & AI Systems Manager

**Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Founder**



Are you obsessed with AI, love building systems, and have a fun, magnetic personality that makes connecting with people feel effortless?



I'm looking for a **tech-savvy, creative, highly proactive right-hand person** to help me scale my personal brand, build AI-powered systems, manage our digital communities, and bring exciting projects to life.



I'm a wellness entrepreneur, founder of The Patch Method™, host of The Biohacked Method Podcast, and creator of a growing personal brand focused on biohacking, entrepreneurship, wellness, and living an optimized life.



We're building something exciting, and I want someone who loves AI, innovation, creativity, community, and making big ideas happen.



**This is NOT your typical virtual assistant position.**



I'm looking for someone who can take an idea, figure out the technology, build the system, automate the process, and confidently run with it.



## WHAT YOU'LL OWN



**1. AI Systems & Business Automation (Top Priority)**



- Build and optimize AI-powered business systems using Claude AI.

- Create Claude Projects, reusable AI skills, workflows, and specialized AI assistants.

- Build automations and processes that eliminate repetitive manual work.

- Connect tools, organize information, and create scalable business workflows.

- Identify opportunities to use AI to make the business run smarter and faster.

- Research, test, and implement emerging AI tools.

- Document processes and create organized, easy-to-use SOPs.



**2. GoHighLevel & Digital Infrastructure**



- Build and manage funnels, landing pages, forms, and CRM workflows in GoHighLevel.

- Set up automated
/SMS follow-ups, lead nurturing, and booking sequences.

- Create organized pipelines for events, inquiries, and customer relationships.

- Maintain and optimize lead capture and conversion systems.

- Integrate GoHighLevel with other tools and platforms.



**3. Personal Brand & Instagram Community**



- Help grow and nurture an engaged community on Instagram.

- Respond to comments, DMs, and community conversations in my authentic brand voice.

- Proactively engage with followers, creators, entrepreneurs, and potential collaborators.

- Support content scheduling, community initiatives, and audience growth.

- Bring creative ideas, positive energy, and genuine enthusiasm to our online community.

- Help turn followers into meaningful relationships and brand advocates.



**4. Website & Digital Projects**



- Help build and update websites and landing pages using Claude AI and modern AI website-building tools.

- Support website improvements, lead magnets, opt-in pages, and digital experiences.

- Coordinate the technical setup of new offers, digital products, and launches.

- Troubleshoot issues and find solutions independently.



**5. CEO Dinner Series & Event Systems**



- Build an organized, automated system for our CEO Women's Dinner Series.

- Manage event inquiries, applications, guest bookings, and confirmations.

- Create automated follow-up sequences, reminders, and post-event communication.

- Organize guest databases, attendee information, and relationship tracking.

- Help create an elevated, seamless guest experience from booking through follow-up.

- Build repeatable systems so future events run effortlessly.



**6. Founder & Personal Brand Support**



- Help turn my ideas into organized, actionable projects.

- Coordinate special projects, launches, partnerships, and personal brand initiatives.

- Keep projects moving forward, follow up on details, and proactively anticipate needs.

- Support light administrative and personal assistant responsibilities as needed.

- Be the person who says, "I've already figured out how to make that happen!"



## WHO YOU ARE



We're looking for someone who is:



- **AI OBSESSED:** You love Claude AI, experiment with new tools, and genuinely enjoy creating AI-powered systems.

- **TECHNICALLY STRONG:** You can confidently build workflows, funnels, automations, and integrations.

- **FUN & BUBBLY:** You have an upbeat, warm, magnetic personality and genuinely enjoy connecting with people.

- **PROACTIVE:** You don't need someone telling you every little step. You take initiative and find solutions.

- **CREATIVE:** You bring fresh ideas and love finding smarter ways to do things.

- **HIGHLY ORGANIZED:** You can manage multiple projects and keep systems running smoothly.

- **RESOURCEFUL:** If you don't know how to do something, you figure it out.

- **EXCELLENT COMMUNICATOR:** Your written English is natural, personable, and engaging.

- **GROWTH-MINDED:** You love learning, building, and being part of an ambitious company.



## MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Strong hands-on experience using **Claude AI**, including Projects, advanced prompting, and building repeatable AI workflows.

- Proven experience with **GoHighLevel**, including CRM, funnels, automation, pipelines, and booking systems.

- Experience with workflow automation tools and integrations.

- Confidence using AI-assisted website development tools.

- Instagram community management experience with an authentic, personable communication style.

- Excellent English writing and communication skills.

- Strong project management, organization, and independent problem-solving abilities.



**BONUS POINTS FOR:**



- Shopify experience

- Klaviyo
 marketing experience

- Make, Zapier, or n8n automations

- Claude Code or other AI coding tools

- Canva and social media content support

- Experience with event management and booking systems

- Experience supporting a U.S.-based founder, entrepreneur, or personal brand

- Interest in wellness, biohacking, entrepreneurship, and personal development



## POSITION DETAILS



**Location:** Philippines (remote)



**Schedule:** Full-time, 40 hours per week, with required overlap during Arizona business hours



**Role:** Long-term position with opportunities for growth and increased responsibility



**Compensation:** Competitive, based on technical expertise and demonstrated experience



## HOW TO APPLY



I want to see your personality AND your technical skills!



Please submit:



1. **Your resume and portfolio** with examples of AI systems, websites, automations, or GoHighLevel projects you've built.

2. **A 60–90-second introduction video** telling me who you are, what you love about AI, and why you'd be an amazing fit.

3. **Your favorite AI project:** Tell me about something you've personally built using Claude AI. What problem did it solve?

4. **GoHighLevel experience:** Share an example of a funnel, booking system, or automation you've created.

5. **Your availability and expected monthly compensation in PHP.**



**Bonus:** Tell me one way you'd use AI to make a busy founder's life dramatically easier.



I'm looking for someone who is excited to build, create, innovate, and grow alongside me. If you love both technology AND people, this could be an incredible fit.

title: Sales Executive (Closer)
description:
Sales Executive (Closers)



A fantastic opportunity to join us as a full-time Sales Executive.



Join a high-performing sales team where you’ll speak with motivated leads, close high-value deals, and earn strong performance-based commissions in a structured, supportive environment.



Pay Rates



$2,000+ per month (base salary + OTE).



Hours Per Week

Minimum 40 hours for base salary.



Working Hours

8 hours per day on a set 5 out of 7 days per week.



Payment

Salary and commissions paid monthly directly into your bank account.



Other Incentives

Performance and other bonus incentives.



About the Company



Swoosh English is an online English exam academy founded in 2013. We help healthcare professionals and other international students pass their OET, IELTS, and PTE exams through online courses, lessons, and expert support.



We have over 500 reviews and a 4.8 Trustpilot rating.



About the Role



We are looking for a confident, persuasive, commission-driven Sales Executive who is comfortable asking for the sale and working in a target-driven environment.



You will be closing warm leads who have already gone through a vetted and filtered process. By the time leads speak with you, they are typically much closer to buying our services.



You must be able to build trust quickly, communicate naturally, handle objections with confidence, and move conversations towards a decision.



This role suits someone who is highly driven by performance, enjoys targets, thrives on commission, and knows how to turn interest into sales.



Who This Role Is For



You are confident asking for the sale.

You are motivated by targets, commissions, and performance.

You are persuasive, energetic, and comfortable speaking with people from around the world.

You know how to handle objections and move conversations forward.

You want to work in a fast-moving, ambitious online business.



Who This Role Is Not For



You are uncomfortable asking for the sale.

You are looking for a passive support-based role.

You do not enjoy sales targets or commission-based incentives.

You struggle with spoken English or persuasive communication.

You prefer a slow-paced or highly structured corporate environment.



Daily Responsibilities



Conduct professional video sales calls with high-quality audio, video, and lighting.

Follow established sales processes and frameworks.

Handle leads and follow-ups via email, WhatsApp, SMS, and phone.

Organise, track, and nurture leads using CRM systems.

Monitor your own sales performance, closing ratios, and KPIs.

Attend weekly sales meetings and in-house sales training.

Provide sales updates and reporting.

Work closely with the Sales Manager and senior management team.



Requirements



At least 2 years of relevant and demonstrable sales experience in a similar closing role.

Proven experience meeting and exceeding sales KPIs and targets.

Professional or business English level of C1 or above.

Strong ability to build rapport and carry natural conversations with international customers.

A natural salesperson who is self-motivated, proactive, and hungry to maximise commissions.

Strong objection-handling and closing ability.

Comfortable speaking with prospective clients over video, phone, email, and chat.

Technically competent and able to use CRM systems and online tools.

Able to work effectively in an ambitious and fast-paced small business.

Able to work under pressure with strong attention to detail.

Proactive, organised, and able to plan ahead.

Fast and stable internet connection.

Access to a sufficiently powerful laptop or PC (16GB RAM, i5 or equivalent processor, at least 3.5 GHz).

Access to a tidy and professional workspace with good lighting, video, and audio.

Enthusiastic, optimistic, and dependable.

Professional, approachable, and a strong listener.

Team player with strong written and verbal communication skills.

Sense of humour and positive attitude.

Genuine interest in helping students improve their English and pass their exam.



Software and Tools Used



Training will be provided where needed.

Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Docs, Google Sheets).

GoHighLevel CRM.

Google Meet.

Website navigation.

Phone, SMS, and WhatsApp.



Perks



Regular sales training and workshops.

Remote work-from-home role.

Flexible working opportunities.

Uncapped commission potential.

Performance bonuses.

Friendly, multicultural, dynamic online company.

Free English test-prep course (IELTS, OET, or PTE), or a credit for a friend or family member of your choosing.

If you are eligible, we will contact you with the next steps in the application process.

title: Content & Social Media Manager (Remote)
description:
Beautygirl & Co | Brow & Lash Studio / brow educator | Sydney, Australia



Pay: $6-9usd per hour, depending on experience

Hours: 20-30 hours per week to start, growing to 30 once output and quality are consistently met

Type: Contract, ongoing, remote

Availability: Responding between [9am–5pm] Sydney time (AEDT), Monday to Friday

Start date: asap

Who this suits



Someone organised, self-directed, creative and genuinely good with people.



You know how to plan, edit and market content in any niche. You think like a marketer, not just an editor. You don’t only make what you’re given. You know why it works and what to make next.



If you need to be chased for updates or told what to make every day, this isn’t the role for you.



About us

-We’re a brow and lash studio in Penrith, Sydney.

-We specialise in brow dye, lamination, waxing, shaping, cosmetic tattooing and Korean lash lifting.

-Alongside clients, we run in-person and online training for beauty therapists learning brow dye, wax and lamination, plus the business and marketing side most courses leave out.

-It’s a one-woman operation.



The role

- You’ll keep our online presence alive, our content moving and our inbox handled while I’m behind the chair.

- This isn’t a “post and ghost” job, and it isn’t a “wait to be told” job. I need someone who brings ideas, knows what’s trending, and understands that content exists to sell, not just to fill a feed.



What you’ll be doing

-Content strategy & planning

-Building the monthly content calendar, due by the [20th] of each month

- Researching trending reels, sounds and formats every week

- Pitching 5 reel ideas per week, each with a hook, format and audience

- Pitching 2–3 marketing ideas per week, plus 1 bigger campaign idea per month

- Planning content for our two audiences:

- Clients: local women who want low-maintenance, reliable brows and lashes

- Students: beauty therapists wanting to learn the skills and build a profitable business



Content creation

- Editing reels from raw clips, following our style guide and example videos

- Adding captions to reels

- Writing 3–5 reel and talking-head scripts per week, each with a hook, key points and a call to action

- Building 1–6 carousels per week in Canva from our templates

- Repurposing existing content into carousel captions or stories

- Transcribing videos and reels



Engagement & outreach (1 hour per day)

- Reaching out to 20–30 potential students and beauty creators daily

- Leaving 10–15 genuine comments on other accounts daily

- Sending outreach DMs using our scripts

- Replying to comments with real engagement, not one-word replies

- Editing and posting stories daily, then replying to engagement



 marketing - bonus if you know it room for extra hours per week - using flodesk



Admin

- Pulling and formatting 2–3 testimonials or reviews per week for stories for each page, I have a salon page and page used for educating and targeting students

Keeping the shared Canva and Google Drive folders tidy and up to date



Workload expectations

-Everything comes with templates, style guides, scripts and raw footage, so the work is set up to move fast.

-Reels: approx. 30 minutes per reel, building to 6 reels per day at full hours

-Carousels: 2–3 per hour from templates, 1–6 per week

-Scripts: 2–3 per hour

-Engagement: 1 hour per day

-Content calendar: delivered by the [20th] each month



These are minimums, not stretch goals. A full daily and weekly schedule will be provided once you start.

If something’s taking longer than expected, tell me early. A problem I hear about on Monday is easy to fix. One I find out about on Friday isn’t.



How we track work

All hours are logged in on your preferred platfrom, work created sent back or logged daily and market off daily tasks

An end-of-shift update goes into Notion or WhatsApp: what’s done, what’s in progress, and links to finished work

Weekly Friday check-in via voice note

Output is reviewed against tracked hours every week



Trial period: The first 4 weeks are a trial, with a review at the end.



What you need (non-negotiable)

- Content planning. You can build a monthly calendar from scratch with clear pillars, a mix of formats, and a purpose behind every post.

- Creative direction. You come up with original ideas, spot trends early, and adapt them to any brand’s voice.

- Editing. A paid CapCut Pro account and strong skills: hooks, pacing, cutting to sound, transitions, text animation, captions, colour correction and keyframes.

- Marketing & selling online. You understand how content moves people from viewer → follower → enquiry → paying customer (training will also be given for direction on ways we need marketing done as well)

- A portfolio of content you’ve created for a brand

- A typing speed of 40–60 WPM minimum (screenshot of a typing test required)

- Strong written English with a warm, natural tone

- Confidence in Canva, Instagram,
, Google Drive, and Google Docs or Notion



Confidentiality

- All content, scripts, templates, course material and client information remain the property of Beautygirl & Co and must be kept confidential.



How to apply - paid trial to serious applicants 

- Use points to apply, leave your portfolio link in application, 

- A short intro about you

- Links to your portfolio or accounts you’ve managed

- Your typing test screenshot

- 3 reel ideas for Beautygirl & Co, with a hook for each:

- One for clients

- One for students

- One based on a trend you’ve seen this month



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid, timed trial task: editing 2 reels and 1 carousel from our templates.

MindDiary is an early-stage practice management platform built for therapists and counsellors in Ireland and the UK. It helps practitioners manage enquiries, client intake, appointments, notes, payments and between-session engagement in one place.



We are hiring a full-time Business Development Associate to help us find, engage and onboard our first group of customers. You will work directly with the founder and play an important role in developing MindDiary’s sales process.



What you will do



• Research independent therapists, counsellors and small therapy practices in Ireland and the UK

• Identify relevant prospects and build accurate contact lists

• Contact prospects through personalised email, LinkedIn and phone outreach

• Have professional and friendly conversations with potential customers

• Understand how therapists currently manage appointments, intake forms, notes and payments

• Identify suitable prospects and schedule product demonstrations with the founder

• Follow up consistently with prospects and demo attendees

• Help convert interested therapists into early customers or design partners

• Assist new customers during their initial onboarding

• Keep contact information, conversations and lead statuses updated in the CRM

• Collect customer feedback and report recurring needs, questions and objections

• Test different outreach approaches and improve them based on results

• Provide a clear weekly report covering outreach, replies, conversations, demos and outcomes



What we are looking for



• Strong spoken and written English

• Confident and professional communication over email, phone and video calls

• Experience in business development, sales, appointment setting, lead generation or customer service

• Comfortable initiating conversations with new prospects and handling rejection professionally

• Able to personalise outreach instead of sending generic mass messages

• Strong research, organisation and follow-up skills

• Dependable, self-motivated and comfortable working independently

• Willing to learn the MindDiary product and understand the needs of therapists

• Available full-time with substantial overlap with Ireland and UK business hours

• Reliable internet connection, working computer and a quiet environment for calls



Nice to have



• Experience selling SaaS or other online services

• Experience working with healthcare, therapy, wellness or professional-services businesses

• Familiarity with CRM systems, LinkedIn prospecting and cold
 tools

• Previous experience working remotely with an international company

• Experience supporting customer onboarding or delivering software demonstrations



Working hours



This is a full-time remote position requiring 40 hours per week. Your schedule must include substantial overlap with Ireland and UK business hours because prospects will be contacted during their working day.



Compensation



• US$500 per month

• Additional performance bonuses based on qualified demonstrations and paying customers

• Long-term opportunity with compensation reviews as MindDiary grows



How success will be measured



• Suitable prospects researched and contacted

• Quality and personalisation of outreach

• Positive responses and qualified conversations

• Product demonstrations scheduled and attended

• Consistency and quality of follow-ups

• Paying customers generated

• Accuracy of CRM records and weekly reporting



How to apply



Please include the following:



1. A short introduction explaining your relevant experience

2. An example of how you previously generated leads, meetings or customers

3. A 60–90 second voice or video introduction

4. A short sample message you would send to an independent therapist in Ireland to introduce MindDiary

5. Your availability in Irish time

6. Confirmation that you are comfortable with the US$500 monthly salary



Please personalise your application and mention MindDiary. Generic applications that do not address the role will not be considered.

title: Client Support & Lead Follow-Up VA — Online Fitness Coaching (Part-Time)
description:
I’m Brad, founder of Built Different, a UK-based online fitness coaching business. I’m looking for an organised, reliable VA to help monitor client engagement, follow up new coaching enquiries, manage Instagram DMs and handle smaller admin tasks.



CLIENT MANAGEMENT



You’ll review client activity in Trainerize (my coaching app) and Systemize (my CRM/coaching management system).



I currently have around 30 clients, rising to almost 50 during peak months leading up to summer.



You’ll check whether clients are logging to my coaching app like their diet and training, completing habits essential to their goals, and signing into the app.



In Systemize (CRM) we use four sections:

- First 30 Days: clients in their first month.

- Red: clients who need immediate attention.

- Amber: clients who are coasting or struggling with consistency.

- Green: clients who are doing well.

You’ll keep clients in the correct section, moving them between stages using agreed criteria.



You’ll send me a clear client action list, ready for my morning follow-ups by 8 am UK time. Include who needs attention, why, relevant dates and context, and when you checked their activity.



I’ll personally contact existing clients and handle coaching decisions. Your job is to take care of the checking, organisation and preparation.



LEAD MANAGEMENT



When someone completes our
 lead form, you’ll receive an
 notification. They have the option to visit our video sales page and join the programme straight away.



They also receive an
 within the first 20 minutes linking to a separate coaching application form. This asks further questions to qualify them and, once completed, takes them back to the video sales page.



Your main responsibility is to follow up leads who haven’t completed that application or joined the programme.



You’ll send our pre-written WhatsApp message as soon as reasonably possible during your working hours, aiming to make first contact within 24 hours. Earlier contact is preferred, but you won’t be expected to be available around the clock.



Check each lead’s current stage before messaging. Find out what’s preventing them from completing the application and help them take that next step.



Keep contact notes, application status and follow-up actions accurate in Systemize. Follow the agreed process for leads who have applied but haven’t joined, and refer questions needing my input to me.



INSTAGRAM DM MANAGEMENT



Manage Instagram DMs during agreed working hours. Respond to enquiries, share appropriate links—including lead magnets, web pages and coaching applications—and have sales conversations with interested prospects using agreed guidance.



Keep track of follow-ups and refer anything needing my input to me.



GENERAL SUPPORT



You’ll also help with agreed admin tasks, maintain clear records, protect client information and flag anything needing my attention.



WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Good organisation, attention to detail and reliable follow-through.

- Experience in customer support, lead follow-up or appointment setting is valuable.

- Previous experience with Trainerize and Systemize/GoHighLevel is helpful, but not essential.

- Confidence learning new systems, working independently and knowing when to ask for help.



HOURS, PAY AND FLEXIBILITY



Pay is a fixed US$450 per month for an expected workload of around 20 hours per week, Monday to Friday.



You’ll manage your own time across the week, spending more time on busier days and less on quieter ones. As long as you get the work done I'm happy.



In return, I expect consistently high standards, deadlines met and reliable lead follow-up during agreed coverage times. If the workload is an issue in this time flag it and we can discuss.



As Built Different grows so will your role, responsibilities and earnings. I'm bringing you in now at a quieter time in our program to get used to the role. Come January I’m looking to have someone I can count on and who I can trust to be a valued part of the business as we grow.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send a brief introduction covering your relevant experience, the systems you’ve used, your availability in UK time and your earliest start date.



Please also answer these two scenarios:

1. Client management

A client hasn’t been logging their diet or training, completing habits essential to their goals, or signing into Trainerize (coaching app).



What do you think you should do in this scenario and how often would you review client activity, and why?



2. Lead management

A new lead has completed our
 lead form but 
’t joined the programme or completed the separate coaching application form sent to them by
. Completing that application helps us identify them as a quality lead.



Write an example WhatsApp message you would send to find out what’s stopping them and help them complete the application. Then let me know what you think the best follow up approach would be to try close this lead.



Please keep your application specific to this role. I’m looking for clear communication, sound judgement and evidence that you follow through.

title: Dental Insurance & Billing Specialist
description:
Sola Kids Dental & Orthodontics | Remote



Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM Pacific Time

Reports to: ROC Team Leader



About Us

Sola Kids Dental & Orthodontics is a growing dental group in Los Angeles, California, with four offices offering general dentistry and orthodontics to kids, teens, and adults. Our Remote Operations Coordinators (ROCs) work behind the scenes as the Office Manager’s best partner, with one goal: maximize production and collections so our teams can focus on patients.



About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-driven insurance and billing specialist to join our ROC team. You’ll make sure every patient has verified coverage before they walk in, every visit is billed right the first time, every payment lands in the right place, and every ortho account stays accurate from banding to retention. You’ll work across PPO and Denti-Cal (Medi-Cal Dental), for both general dentistry and orthodontics.



What You’ll Own



Eligibility and benefit breakdowns



Verify Denti-Cal and PPO eligibility for scheduled patients ahead of their visits, and flag anyone without active coverage

Build accurate PPO benefit breakdowns in Open Dental (maximums, deductibles, frequencies, waiting periods, coverage percentages, and ortho benefits such as lifetime maximums, age limits, and payment frequency)

Prepare routing slips 2 days ahead so insurance details match the schedule, and check the schedule throughout the day for newly added appointments

Keep patient insurance information clean and current (subscriber details, plan updates, coordination of benefits)

Alert the office and call center to inactive, terminated, or changed coverage so patients can be contacted before their visit



Payment posting and account accuracy



Post PPO and Denti-Cal insurance payments (EOBs/ERAs) quickly and accurately, and keep patient ledgers clean and balanced

Post 
 payments and keep payment records clean

Upload and attach eligibility and supporting documentation to the correct patient charts and claims



Orthodontic billing



Submit and track orthodontic insurance claims for PPO patients (initial banding, monthly/periodic billing, retention)

Monitor ortho payment plans and patient balances, and flag missed payments or discrepancies

Learn our Denti-Cal ortho process over time (we’ll train you)



Claims follow-up and audits



Work denials, rejections, and aging AR; follow up with carriers and submit appeals when needed

Audit claims and balances proactively so errors are caught early, not “fixed later”

Double-check Denti-Cal and PPO policies to prevent denials and appeals

Keep clear notes in Open Dental, close every loop with the offices, and escalate chart, billing, or documentation issues quickly and clearly



What Good Looks Like (our READY standard)



Routing Slips Prepared: Every patient’s eligibility is verified before they arrive, and routing slips match the schedule so the office can execute immediately.

Ensure Schedule & Record Accuracy: Extreme attention to detail. Insurance and billing information is entered correctly and readable for the office.

Audit & Bill Daily: Breakdowns are accurate, claims are correct, balances make sense, and errors are caught early.

Dedicated to the Office: Strong ownership mindset. You keep a running task list, close loops with confirmation, and take work off the manager’s plate.

Yield Maximum Production: Fewer eligibility surprises, fewer denials, fewer billing mistakes, and no production left on the table.



Requirements



2+ years of US dental insurance experience, including eligibility verification, benefit breakdowns, and payment posting (PPO required)

US orthodontic billing experience and a strong understanding of how ortho insurance pays over the course of treatment

Experience working denials, appeals, and AR follow-up with US carriers

Comfortable with payer portals and phone verifications

Excellent written and spoken English

Able to work ahead of the schedule and manage high daily volume without sacrificing accuracy

Proactive and dependable in a remote setting: you close loops and confirm your work

Reliable computer, fast stable internet, and a quiet workspace with backup power and internet

Available to work US Pacific Time hours



Nice to Have



Denti-Cal/Medi-Cal experience (strong plus)

Open Dental experience

Experience with patient financing or payment plan platforms such as 

A dental nerd at heart who wants to understand not just the “what” but the “why” behind our policies



Why Join Us



Long-term, stable full-time role

Paid training with a supportive, experienced team



How to Apply

Send the following:



Your resume

A short summary of your dental insurance and ortho billing experience (practices, software used, typical daily volume)

title: Appointment Setter — US Real Estate Investing (Phone Sales, EST Hours)
description:
TYPE: Full-time · SALARY: $600–$2,000/month (base + performance) · HOURS: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM EST, Mon–Fri (1 hr break)



READ THIS FIRST



This is a phone job. You will be on calls with American real estate investors for most of your shift. If you are looking for admin, data entry, or general VA work, this is not it.



We are a US company that helps investors buy cash-flowing apartment buildings. We do the sourcing, the analysis, and the negotiation. Our clients invest $40,000 or more.



Your job is to get the right people onto our calendar and make sure they show up.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



Two power blocks each day calling leads already in our CRM — people who opted in, requested information, or spoke with us before. This is not cold calling strangers. They know who we are.



Golden hours taking inbound calls from new leads who just requested information.



Qualifying every prospect against a hard gate: available capital, credit, decision-maker, timeline.



Booking qualified prospects into a Deep Dive call with our Executive Consultant.



A 2-minute check-in call after every booking to confirm they watched the pre-call video and will attend.



Logging every call in our CRM the same day. No exceptions.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Phone sales experience is required. Appointment setting, inside sales, BPO outbound, or similar. Tell us exactly what you sold, to whom, and your numbers.

American-sounding English. Clear, natural, confident. US clients must be comfortable with you in the first ten seconds.

You can hold a frame. Our prospects are often successful, direct, and sometimes dominant. Some will push back hard or dodge the capital question. You need to ask again, politely and without flinching, until you get a real answer. If you tend to agree with people to keep things pleasant, you will not enjoy this role.

You are reliable. You show up when scheduled, you hit your call numbers every day without being reminded, and you complete your forms. This matters more to us than talent.

Real estate background is a plus, not required.

Stable internet, a quiet workspace, a working headset, and a backup power plan.



COMPENSATION



Training (first 2 weeks): $4.00/hour.



After training:



Base: $250 per pay period (semi-monthly)

Bonus per qualified Deep Dive that is held

Percentage of program sales from appointments you set

Guaranteed minimum $1,000/month for your first 60 days while you ramp

Realistic earnings once producing: $1,200–$2,000/month



Top performers earn the top of that range. We pay for results, and we pay on time.



TRAINING AND SUPPORT



Two weeks of direct 1-on-1 training with the CEO, 2–4 hours per day, plus self-study and recorded call review. You get the script, the objection framework, and recordings of real calls.



After training: two meetings per week. We are not going to micromanage you. We will give you clear targets and expect you to hit them. If you have a better idea about how we do something, we want to hear it — that is how our operations lead works and it works well.



HOW TO APPLY — FOLLOW ALL THREE STEPS



Applications missing any step will not be reviewed. This is intentional.



1. Start your message with the word BLUEPRINT so we know you read this.



2. Answer these in writing:



What have you sold on the phone, to whom, and what were your numbers?

Describe one call where the prospect pushed back hard and you did not back down. What did you say?

Why did you leave your last phone role?



3. Record a 2-minute voice sample (any recorder, send a link):



First minute: introduce yourself as if calling a US investor who filled out our form.

Second minute: the prospect says “I’d rather not share how much capital I have.” Respond as you would on a live call. Do not script it perfectly — we want to hear how you actually sound.



We review within 3 business days. Shortlisted candidates do one live role-play with the CEO.

- You own your accounts. The results, the spend and the client relationship are yours.

- Reliability beats brilliance. Every working day, every meeting, the same standard.

- No surprises. Spend never runs past what a client has funded, and nothing is promised to a client that hasn't been agreed.

- Every account is safe before you sign off for the weekend.



WHAT YOU GET



- $600–1,200/month to start, based on experience, paid in USD

s and chats (order status, tracking, returns, refunds, product questions). You can work directly in our inbox or, if you like, with our AI dashboard that prepares draft replies for you

 what gets made

 with the subject line: Your Personal Brand Strategist - [Your Full Name]

title: Direct Response Copywriter (WFH / Remote)
description:
Full-time | Remote Setup/Work from Home

Working Hours: 9AM - 6PM (SGT)

Salary: SGD 1,000+ monthly (with performance bonuses)



About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Our clients are top producers in their industry, and they don’t pay us for views or pretty content. They pay us for leads, booked calls and closed business.



This role is a big part of that engine. Your job is to come up with strong angles for each client, and then write everything that carries those angles: video ad scripts, image ads, landing page copy, VSL scripts, Meta ad copy, and follow-up
s and WhatsApp messages. Your work runs on live campaigns with real budgets, and you’ll know within days whether it worked. If that excites you, keep reading.



What the setup looks like

You’ll join our ads department and work alongside team members with different specialist skill sets across media buying, funnels and creative, plus our strategists and the founder. We serve a growing base of ad clients and we’re scaling fast. Main channel is Meta. Market is Singapore. Niches are financial advisory and real estate, which means trust-based selling.



What you’ll do

• Come up with strong angles for each client based on their positioning, audience and offer

• Write high converting video ad scripts, image ad copy, VSL scripts, landing page copy and Meta ad copy

• Write follow-up
s and WhatsApp messages that keep leads moving towards booked calls

• Review results weekly with the ads lead, spot the winning angles, and write the next round based on data

• Write for real Singapore FA and RE audiences based on what they actually think and want. No generic “financial freedom” filler

• Build our angle library as you go, so every winning angle compounds for the whole team



How you’ll be measured

Hit rate. Out of every batch of scripts you write, a minimum share needs to become winners: strong lead costs, campaigns that can scale. Our current bar is at least 2 winners out of every 8 video scripts. You’ll see your numbers every week. Good writers want to be measured. It’s how you prove you’re good.



You’ll do well here if you

• Care about the difference between copy that reads well and copy that converts, and chase the second

• Rewrite your own hooks before anyone asks

• Study why an ad worked, not just that it worked

• Take feedback well. Your copy gets reviewed, tested and sometimes rewritten. That’s how everyone here improves, including us



This is not for you if you

• Want a job where you clock in, clear tasks and clock out at 6 sharp

• Have freelance clients or side hustles competing for your focus. We’re not saying no life outside work. We’re saying this has to be your main thing, because split attention shows in the work

• Prefer writing from templates instead of thinking through the audience and angle each time



No hard feelings either way. We’d rather both sides know now.



Bonus points

• You’ve written copy for service professionals

• Bigger bonus: financial advisors or real estate specifically

• Biggest bonus: you’ve done it for the Singapore market



What you get

• Your work runs on live campaigns with real budgets. Fast feedback, real stakes, visible results

• Direct access to the founder and strategists. You learn how campaigns are actually planned, not just briefed

• A team that invests in growth: internal masterminds, sponsored courses, and overseas team trips

• Real room to grow into a senior copy and strategy role as we scale



How to apply



 
 with the subject line: 

Your Next Copywriter - [Your Full Name]

Your
 should include:

• Cover letter: years of copywriting experience and how you think you can contribute to Trident Digital

• Updated CV/Resume

• Portfolio: your 3 best pieces of ad copy or scripts, with 2 to 3 sentences on each explaining the choices you made

• One short exercise: pick any ad you’ve seen that you think is weak, and rewrite the hook. A few lines is enough. We’re looking at how you think

• Expected salary in SGD



Important Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered. The exercise is part of the screening. It tells us more than a CV can.

title: Amazon Listings Specialist — Part-Time, 15–20 Hours per Week — UK Food Gifting Brand
description:
Tilz Collection is a UK food gifting brand with around 60 products, selling across Amazon marketplaces in the UK, Europe and internationally.



We are looking for an experienced listings specialist to take ownership of our listing content and accuracy. You will work alongside a separate PPC specialist and our existing team to improve product pages, complete missing listing content and maintain accurate product information.



THE WORK



• Write and improve titles, bullet points, descriptions and backend search terms using relevant keyword research.

• Identify and resolve content-related issues preventing listings from going live, escalating account or operational issues to the appropriate team member.

• Keep product information accurate and consistent across marketplaces.

• Create A+ Content copy and coordinate image and design requirements with our team.

• Identify when a performance problem is caused by the copy—and explain clearly when the issue lies elsewhere.

• Coordinate translated listings across our European marketplaces, checking product facts, completeness and consistency, and arranging language review where needed. You do not need to speak every language.



WHAT MATTERS MOST



This is a writing job as much as an Amazon job. Our product pages need to help customers understand what they are buying and why it makes a good gift.



We need clear, persuasive and accurate written English, with a strong understanding of British customers and natural keyword use.



We sell food, so ingredients, allergens and dietary suitability must be checked against approved product information and never guessed. If information is missing or contradictory, we expect you to flag it before publication.



You should have practical experience creating and improving Amazon listings, be comfortable working independently and deliver copy that does not need extensive rewriting.



THE TERMS



• US$4.00–US$5.00 per hour, depending on demonstrated writing quality.

• 15–20 hours per week, with the intention of a long-term arrangement.

• Flexible hours, with some overlap with UK working hours agreed with you.

• Target start: week commencing 9 November 2026.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send the following instead of a general cover letter:



Open this Amazon UK listing: 
.



Write one improved product title and one improved bullet point.



Use only information shown on the listing. Do not add any unsupported claim, ingredient, allergen or dietary statement. If you spot something unclear or contradictory, flag it rather than guessing.



Explain your changes in two or three sentences.



Briefly describe your Amazon listing experience and share one example of a listing you personally created or improved.



Confirm your hourly rate within the advertised range, the hours you can commit to each week, your current work commitments and earliest start date.



Please write the sample yourself, without AI-generated copy. The interview will include a short live writing exercise.



This short sample is for recruitment assessment only and will not be published or used commercially.



Use “LISTINGS — TEA Gift” as your application subject.



We aim to contact shortlisted applicants by Thursday 5 November 2026.

title: Senior KYC/KYB Analyst
description:
About Us



We are an international company working with a remote team in the Philippines since 2008. We value professionalism, collaboration, and the ability to adapt in a fast-paced global environment. Our team thrives on mutual respect, accountability, and continuous improvement, and we’re looking for someone who shares these values.



About You

We are looking for a highly accurate, detail-oriented, and analytical KYC/KYB Analyst to join our Compliance team. You will be responsible for conducting KYC and KYB checks, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting our onboarding and verification processes. The ideal candidate has strong attention to detail, works with integrity, and is comfortable handling sensitive information.



RESPONSIBILITIES

Own end-to-end KYC and KYB reviews for individual and corporate customers, from onboarding through approval, rejection or escalation.

Review and verify identity documents, proof of address, company registration documents, and complex ownership and control structures, identifying all ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) and controllers.

Carry out Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) on high-risk customers, including PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions, complex or opaque structures, crypto/Web3 businesses and unusual activity profiles.

Assess and evidence source of funds and source of wealth, and challenge customers where the explanation or documents are inconsistent or insufficient.

Perform AML screening (sanctions, PEP, adverse media), resolve potential matches and document a clear rationale for each decision.

Complete customer risk assessments, assign risk ratings and recommend approval, conditional approval or rejection for complex and high-risk cases.

Escalate suspicious activity and red flags to the Head of Compliance, with well-documented case summaries to support any internal suspicious activity report.

Run periodic reviews and re-verification based on customer risk level, including trigger-based reviews when ownership, activity or risk profile changes.

Manage verification workflows in Sumsub (or similar KYC/AML tools), including configuring checks, resolving system issues and flagging improvements.

Respond to requests for information (RFIs) from banking and payment partners, preparing clear, complete case files within agreed timelines

Work with Support, Business, Product and Tech teams across multiple business units to resolve discrepancies, chase outstanding information and unblock stuck cases.

Contribute to improving KYC/KYB procedures, checklists and risk-assessment frameworks in line with regulatory requirements and partner expectations.

Keep accurate, audit-ready records for every check and decision.

Handle confidential and sensitive customer data with discretion, in line with data protection requirements.



REQUIREMENTS:

1–3 years of proven, hands-on experience in KYC and KYB verification, with a strong focus on reviewing and validating KYB documentation

Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, with the ability to efficiently identify inconsistencies, risks, and missing information

Proven experience following and adhering to internal SOPs, regulatory requirements, and compliance guidelines

Hands-on experience using Sumsub or similar AML/KYC tools (e.g., Veriff, Onfido, Persona, ComplyAdvantage)

Solid understanding of AML, KYC, and compliance processes, particularly in a B2B context

Clear and professional communication skills, both written and verbal

Comfortable working independently and managing time effectively

Availability: Must be available and responsive during the agreed 8-hour shift

Good Internet Connection: Reliable and stable for remote work

Must have a Wise account or reside in a location that supports Wise

title: Operations Manager / Executive VA – US Trucking & Delivery
description:
Vincent Miller Trucking is a US-based delivery and logistics company. We contract

independent cargo van drivers who run dedicated Walmart retail delivery routes across

multiple states through our contracts with Curri and JW Logistics. During our peak

season we run 45 vans across 26 route locations, and we are growing.

We are looking for one exceptional person to run the day-to-day operations of the company –

not just assist with it. You will work directly with the owner and act as his right hand: recruiting

drivers, managing routes and schedules, handling communication, and keeping records clean.

When the owner is off, you run the show. This is a long-term position with room to grow as the

company grows. What You Will Do

Everything the owner does in his business day – you take it over and own it.

• Driver recruiting and hiring (the most important part of the job): post and rotate job

ads on Indeed, CB Drivers, and
 job groups; text and call applicants the

same day; screen them; walk them through onboarding until they are fully ready to

drive.

• Route coverage: make sure every route always has a driver. Track all routes in a coverage

tracker, confirm hired drivers are active, arrange backup drivers, and escalate immediately

if a route risks going uncovered.

• Scheduling: build and maintain weekly route schedules, manage 7-day assignments and

split schedules, and keep backup driver information current.

• Communication: answer driver calls,
s, and texts daily using our FAQ sheets; give

clear answers; take messages for the owner when needed and make sure every message

gets a callback the same day.

• Onboarding and payroll support: collect driver documents (van photo, license, insurance),

keep every driver's digital folder organized, send onboarding packets (agreement, W-9,

direct deposit), and set drivers up in Paychex Flex.

• Record keeping: maintain the master Excel tracker (routes, drivers, VINs, licenses,

documents) and prepare a simple weekly report for the owner (vans filled vs. open, hires

made, ads posted).

• Stakeholder communication: keep drivers and contract partners (Curri, JW Logistics

coordinators) informed throughout the season with short, professional updates.

• Social media support: post hiring ads and short promotional videos in local

groups for open route cities.

• Anything else the owner needs to hand off, learned quickly and executed 

Who You Are

Vincent Miller Trucking Job Post – Operations Manager (Remote)

• Excellent spoken and written English – you will be on the phone with American

drivers every day, and they must understand you easily and find you pleasant to

talk to.

• Fast learner: we will train you on our systems in week one, and we expect you to run with

it after that.

• Extremely organized – trackers, folders, and checklists are your natural habitat. Nothing

falls through the cracks.

• Proactive: you spot a route without coverage or an applicant waiting and act before being

asked.

• Reliable and available: consistent daily schedule, US business hours, responsive during

working hours.

• Comfortable with: Excel/Google Sheets, Gmail/Outlook, Paychex or willingness to learn it

fast, Indeed,
 groups, and smartphone apps (Curri/Nash).

• Experience in recruiting, dispatch, logistics, transportation, or executive assistance is a

strong plus.



The Offer

• Full-time, long-term position working directly with the owner.

• Work from home – all you need is a quiet space, reliable internet, and a headset.

• US business hours,  8am—10pm

• Salary: $850 /month, paid bi weekly , based on experience – we pay well for

someone who can truly run operations.

• Growth opportunity: as the company adds routes and vans, your role and pay grow with it.



How to Apply

Send us a message with:

• A short voice recording (30-60 seconds) telling us about yourself and your experience –

we hire for clear, friendly English first.

• Your resume or work history.

• Answer these three questions:

• (1) Have you done recruiting, dispatching, or driver coordination before? Tell us about it.

• (2) Describe a time you had to keep many moving pieces organized in one day – what did

you do?

• (3) What is your internet speed and what hours can you work US Eastern Time?

title: Experienced Sales Representative (Remote)
description:
Outbound Sales & Appointment Setter



Remote | Philippines



North London Massage Therapy is looking for an experienced outbound sales professional to join our team.



This is a sales role. It is not a general Virtual Assistant position.



The main purpose of your role is simple: start conversations with prospective businesses, understand their needs and book qualified meetings.



You will spend a significant part of your working time speaking to people on the phone.



What you'll be doing



- Making outbound cold and warm calls to prospective businesses

- Speaking confidently with receptionists, gatekeepers and decision-makers

- Asking good questions and actually listening to the answers

- Identifying potential needs and sales opportunities

- Handling initial objections without immediately giving up

- Communicating the value of our services clearly

- Booking qualified meetings

- Following up prospects by phone and

- Keeping accurate notes and updating our CRM

- Following up existing leads until there is a clear outcome



What we're looking for



You must have previous outbound sales, telesales, appointment-setting or business development experience.



We are looking for someone who:



- Is confident making outbound calls every day

- Can hold a natural conversation rather than simply read a script

- Understands basic sales techniques and objection handling

- Knows when to speak and, importantly, when to listen

- Can ask follow-up questions based on what a prospect actually says

- Is comfortable speaking with business owners and decision-makers

- Can work independently and take ownership of follow-ups

- Has professional-level spoken and written English

- Can communicate clearly, naturally and confidently in English

- Is comfortable being coached and receiving direct feedback



Please don't apply if...



Your experience is mainly general VA work, administration, data entry or
 outreach without significant telephone sales experience.



This role requires someone who is already comfortable selling and speaking to prospects on the phone. We will provide training on our business, services and approach, but we are not looking to teach someone how to sell from scratch.



When applying



Please include:



1. A short summary of your previous outbound sales experience.

2. What you were selling and who you were calling.

3. Approximately how many outbound calls you were making per day.

4. Your experience booking appointments or meetings.

5. A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you'd be good at this role.

6. Link to your updated resume or cv



Applications without relevant outbound calling experience will not be progressed.

title: Remote Phone Sales Rep – Warm Leads, Short 10–15 Min Calls, $10 per Sale
description:
About us

We help people trade the financial markets with AI-powered tools and funded trading capital, without risking their own savings. We are expanding into the US market and are building our phone sales team.



Why this role is different

You don’t chase anyone. Every US lead you call has:



applied through our form

watched our 20-minute info webinar

been fully briefed by our support team



They already know what we offer and what it costs. They’re warm and expecting our call. Your job is to answer their last questions and help them get started.



The role

You make short, focused calls of 10–15 minutes to US leads: confirm their goals, clear up any hesitation and close them on our entry program ($179) right on the call. No cold calling, no prospecting.



What you’ll do



Call warm US leads from your call lists in our CRM (Close, with a built-in power dialer)

Build rapport quickly and confirm the lead’s interest and goals

Answer remaining questions clearly and honestly

Handle common objections such as timing, trust or “I need to think about it”

Close on the call, send the checkout link and follow up until payment is complete

Follow up with leads you couldn’t reach

Log every call: short notes, status and next step



What we’re looking for



Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent

1+ year of phone sales or BPO sales experience; experience calling US customers is a big plus

Confident, friendly and to the point: you can close on the first call without being pushy

Organized, reliable and clean with CRM notes

Night shift: your shift falls within 10 am – 10 pm US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday

Quiet home workspace, stable internet with a backup (e.g. mobile data) and a noise-cancelling headset

You never make income or profit promises, and you follow US calling rules (calls only between 9 am and 9 pm in the lead’s local time)



Compensation (paid monthly in USD)



$750 base in month 1, then $1,000/month once you reach 60 sales in a month

+ $15 commission per sale, no cap

Full-time reps closing 3–5 sales per day earn $1,900–$2,500/month from month 2

Commission is paid on completed, non-refunded sales

Independent contractor, fully home-based



What you get



Warm, pre-educated US leads only: no cold calling

Short calls with a simple offer, so you close on the first call

A proven process that already works in our European market

A growth path into a high-ticket closer role



To apply

Send a 60–90 second voice note or video introducing yourself in English, and answer these 3 questions:



What have you sold by phone before, and what was your close rate?

A lead says “It sounds good, but I need to think about it.” What do you say?

Can you work US hours (night shift in PH time), Monday to Friday?
