The founder, Jamal Hansen, is also a well-known content creator and educator in the tax, wealth, and investing space, with a large and growing audience across Instagram and YouTube where he teaches high earners and business owners how the wealthy actually build and protect money. Before you apply, go check 
 on Instagram and his YouTube channel — that content will tell you exactly who you'd be working for and the level we operate at. The platform is also a real part of the business: it drives clients, capital, and brand partnerships, so you're joining a company that is both an operator and a media presence.



About the Role



You will work directly with the founder, Jamal Hansen — a successful entrepreneur managing multiple companies across tax, real estate, and investments. Your job is to be the analytical engine behind our deals: underwriting acquisitions, building the models, and pressure-testing every number before capital goes to work.



This is not a passive spreadsheet job. We are evaluating deals, raising capital, and acquiring real estate at the same time, often on tight timelines. You need to be the person who can take a raw deal, build a clean model, and tell us in plain language whether it works and where the risk is. If you need every assumption handed to you, this isn't the right fit. If you think in numbers, take ownership of your analysis, and can defend it, keep reading.



As the fund and the portfolio grow, this role grows with it. You will be taught our underwriting frameworks and the tax strategy that sits underneath every deal — but you have to be coachable and genuinely eager to learn. The exposure you'll get sitting at the intersection of real estate, fund operations, and advanced tax strategy is not something you'll pick up anywhere else. We're looking for world-class A-players who want to build something and grow with the company long-term.

This role is vital to the next evolution of the company.



Key Responsibilities



Underwrite real estate acquisitions — build and maintain financial models and pro formas for single-asset and portfolio deals, including BRRRR, value-add, and Section 8 / HCV workforce housing

Run the numbers on every deal — purchase price, rehab, financing, rents, expenses, exit, and returns (IRR, equity multiple, cash-on-cash, DSCR)



Conduct market research and comps on target Midwest markets — rents, vacancy, cap rates, neighborhood and demand trends



Perform deal due diligence — review T-12s, rent rolls, offering memos, and operating statements and flag anything that doesn't add up



Support PAHF fund operations — assist with deal pipeline tracking, investor reporting inputs, and capital deployment analysis

Build and maintain dashboards and trackers for portfolio performance across the property base

Incorporate tax strategy into analysis where relevant — cost segregation, bonus depreciation, and how structure affects investor returns

Prepare clear, decision-ready summaries — turn a full model into a one-page read that tells us go or no-go and why

Take on new analytical responsibilities as the fund and portfolio scale





Who You Are



You are genuinely strong with numbers and financial modeling — this is the core of the role, not a nice-to-have

You are detail-obsessed — you catch the broken formula, the wrong assumption, the number that doesn't tie

You can think independently and form a point of view, not just fill in a template

You can explain a complex model in plain English to someone who isn't going to read every cell

You move fast without getting sloppy and you take ownership of your work

You are coachable, hungry to learn, and want to grow inside a multi-company operation long-term

You are fully fluent in written and spoken English — this is non-negotiable for this role





Requirements



Advanced proficiency in Excel and / or Google Sheets — comfortable building models from scratch (this will be tested)

Demonstrated ability to build pro formas and understand real estate or investment returns

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail

Background or strong interest in real estate, finance, accounting, or investments

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet work environment, and availability during agreed working hours

Full written and spoken English fluency — non-negotiable





Training & Development



Comprehensive training will be provided on our underwriting frameworks, models, and tools before you are expected to execute independently

As new responsibilities are added to this role you will be fully trained on how to complete them before they become part of your regular duties

Certain analyses will be repeated consistently so you will have the opportunity to master them and become the go-to expert in that area

Jamal will personally invest time in teaching you how deals are evaluated across the fund and the portfolio so you understand not just what to model but why it matters

Training materials, SOPs, model templates, and video walkthroughs will be provided and stored in the company Notion and Google Drive library for ongoing reference

You are not expected to know everything on day one — you are expected to learn, apply, and grow





The Opportunity

You won't be buried in a corporate structure. You'll be in the room, seeing how a multi-company operation evaluates and acquires real assets at a high level, and growing with it.

There is real room to grow here for someone who performs.



How to Apply

All applications go through our application form — we will not be accepting resumes by email.



Fill out the form here: 







You'll be asked to provide:



A brief introduction — who you are and why this role makes sense for you right now

Your resume or professional profile link

A link to or screenshot of a financial model, pro forma, or analysis you've built (if you don't have one, briefly describe a deal or number you analyzed and what you concluded)

A short voice or video introduction (60 seconds or less) so we can hear how you communicate



Only applications submitted through the form will be reviewed.

title: Senior Accountant

description:
Job Title: Part-Time Fundraising and Outreach Virtual Assistant



Location: Remote. Applicants from any country are welcome.

Pay: Please provide your hourly rate.



ABOUT THE PROJECT



I’m an actor, playwright, and producer seeking a virtual assistant to support fundraising and outreach for the 2027 US tour of my solo play, The Last Audition.



The production has performed in Adelaide, New York, Montreal and Edinburgh. Upcoming US presentations will offer opportunities for community conversations about memory, identity, aging and caregiving.

Find appropriate contacts and draft personalized outreach
s. Help prepare project summaries, fundraising materials and grant applications. Maintain a spreadsheet tracking prospects, correspondence, deadlines and follow-up, and provide a brief weekly progress report.

Experience in US fundraising research, grant support, or nonprofit development is required. You should have excellent written English, strong research skills, careful attention to detail, and the ability to assess whether an opportunity fits the project.



You should be comfortable using spreadsheets and shared documents, working independently and meeting deadlines.



Experience with performing arts, community engagement, fiscal sponsorship, or outreach to US presenting organizations is particularly welcome.



INITIAL PAID TRIAL

title: Client Acquisition Specialist: Cold Calls, DMs and Other Channels.
description:
We’re hiring client acquisition people who find a way.



Orca Management is a Houston-based performance marketing agency. We run
, Instagram and Google ads for auto detailing, window tint, PPF and ceramic coating shops, and we’re expanding into more industries and more offers. Our goal is to build the best client acquisition team in this space. We want people who are better at it than we are.



This is not a script-reading job. Calls and Instagram DMs are where you start. The real job is finding new, smarter ways to put our offer in front of owners who need it, and proving what works with numbers.



There is a lot of room to grow here, and no cap. We promote from inside. The people who find new ways to bring in clients move up fast: more pay per appointment, more hours, closing calls, and eventually running a team of their own. If you want a ceiling, this isn’t the job. If you want to build, it is.



What you’ll do

Call shop owners in Texas and DM them on Instagram, from a list we prepare. Reach the owner, book a 15-minute call on our calendar, and log every call

Run your own experiments on new acquisition channels (for example: DMs, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, partnerships and referrals, community outreach, content, anything you can show works). Tell us your plan before you spend a dollar or a month on it

Send a short daily report: hours, dials, DMs, conversations, confirmed appointments, and what you tested

Share what you learn so the whole team can copy what works

Pay (clear from day one)

$4 an hour base, including training and the trial. You are never working for free

A minimum of $25 for every appointment that shows up and is confirmed, on top of your base, paid weekly. The more you book, the more you earn, with no cap

$50 minimum for every new client you source (a client who signs and pays their first invoice), paid after that payment clears

Example, not a guarantee: 3 confirmed appointments in a week adds at least $75 on top of base, and one signed client adds $50 for low ticket and up to $250 for higher ticket clients

Weekly payment through Wise or PayPal (We are flexible and can provide other payment options) Independent contractor

The growth ladder

Setter: base plus at least $25 per shown appointment

Acquisition Specialist: a higher per-appointment rate and base once you hit 10 shown appointments in a month, plus the $100 per client you source

Closer: you take the calls you set and earn commission on the clients you close

Team lead: you train and manage new setters and earn on the team’s results

Anyone who builds a new channel that works gets credit for it and a bigger role running it

How it starts

A 60-minute paid training: the offer, the script, the tracker and a practice call

A paid 2-day trial: live calls and DMs, plus a one-page plan with three new ways you’d find clients and which you’d test first. You are paid for the trial whether or not we keep working together

A 2-week probation, then a review with your numbers

We provide



The lead list, call script, tracker, calendar link, training, and weekly feedback on your calls.



You provide



Strong spoken English, a quiet space, a good headset, stable internet, and the discipline to log everything. Curiosity and creativity matter more than years of experience.



The rules of the game

Every claim you make must be true. No made-up results, fake testimonials or fake urgency

Follow the rules of every platform and the law on calls and messages. No spam tricks or workarounds

Anything you build for us (lists, scripts, playbooks) belongs to the company, and you get credit for it

Who this is for



You’re hungry, coachable and a little obsessed with winning. You’d rather test five ideas and find one that works than follow a script. You want a role that grows as fast as your results do.



How to apply (incomplete applications are not reviewed)

A 60-second video or voice note: why you, one time you got a meeting or a client in an unusual way, and what you’d say if a receptionist says “the owner is busy”

Your outbound or acquisition experience with numbers if you have them (dials per day, DMs sent, meetings booked, clients won)

Three ideas, in a few lines each, for finding auto shop owners who need help getting more customers. Which would you test first, and how would you measure it?

Your available hours, internet speed and headset



We reply to every complete application within [3] business days.

title: Behavioral Health Clinic Operations Assistant (2 Openings)
description:
Behavioral Health Clinic Operations Assistant, Oakline Ventures LLC

Full-Time | Remote | Immediate Start



About the Company

We're launching five outpatient behavioral health clinics at the same time, with plans to grow to ten. The clinics are Poppy Rise Behavioral Health in Phoenix, AZ; Nightbloom Rise Recovery in Tucson, AZ; Chamisa Grove Family Counseling in Las Cruces, NM; Yucca Light Behavioral Health in Santa Fe, NM; and Vine Maple Rise Behavioral Health in Portland, OR. Each clinic is its own company under one parent organization, Oakline Ventures LLC. We provide counseling and mental health care and accept Medicaid and commercial insurance. Our partners bring established referral networks in New Mexico and Arizona, so patients will start coming in as soon as each clinic opens.



Meet the Founders

Jamal Hansen is a founder with over 100K followers on Instagram (jamal__hansen) who operates multiple businesses in the tax, finance, insurance, and real estate industries. Anthony Bennett is a founder of over 43 companies in hospitality, real estate, entertainment, and more. Mattie Gaffney is a healthcare entrepreneur with over 
 followers on
 who founded and runs Abloom Health Care and Mindful Minds Counseling, a behavioral health agency in Arizona. This is a real, established team building for the long term, and you'll work with both of them directly. 



About the Role

You'll be one of two operations assistants, each assigned to 1 to 2 clinics. You'll report to the founders, Jamal Hansen and Anthony Bennett. You're the person who gets a clinic from paperwork to its first patients, then keeps it running smoothly.

Detail matters more in this role than almost anywhere else. One missed
 from an insurance company can push a contract back 60 to 90 days, and that delays care and revenue. We need someone who is extremely organized, checks everything twice, and keeps every deadline without being reminded. If you need constant direction, this isn't the right fit. If you love systems, checklists, and a clean inbox, keep reading.



You will be trained in all the intricacies of the job and role. This role will grow as we expand to ten clinics.



What You'll Own

- Entity Setup and Licensing: Track state business filings, city business licenses, and state clinic licensing applications from submission to approval

- Insurance Credentialing: Prepare and submit applications to insurance companies, follow up until you have signed contracts, and keep provider records up to date

- Medicaid Enrollment: Manage enrollment with Arizona's Medicaid program (AHCCCS), New Mexico's Medicaid program (Turquoise Care), and Oregon's Medicaid program (the Oregon Health Plan)

- Insurance Inbox Monitoring: Check the insurance inbox several times a day, log every message, and answer requests the same day

- Patient Intake and Scheduling: Handle new patient inquiries, confirm insurance coverage, send intake forms, and manage provider calendars

- Billing and Admin Support: Help submit insurance claims, follow up on denied claims, track payments, and handle day-to-day admin

- Website and Listings: Keep clinic websites, online directory listings, and referral partner information current

- Tracking and Reporting: Keep a status tracker for every application and send the founders weekly updates



Who You Are

- Extremely organized and detail-oriented; nothing slips through the cracks

- Fluent, professional English, confident on phone and
 with insurance companies, state agencies, and patients

- Calm, kind, and discreet with sensitive patient information

- Independent, coachable, and focused on following systems



Requirements

- Fluent English (non-negotiable)

- 2+ years of US healthcare admin experience, such as credentialing, medical billing, or intake

- Experience with Medicaid or commercial insurance enrollment strongly preferred

- Understanding of HIPAA, the US law that protects patient privacy

- Google Workspace proficiency, plus strong spreadsheet and tracking skills

- Experience with electronic health records software a plus

- Available during US business hours, Mountain and Pacific time

- Reliable internet and a private workspace



Why This Role

You'll help launch five healthcare clinics from the ground up and grow with us to ten. You'll work directly with the founders, have real ownership over your clinics, and have room to grow into a lead role.



How to Apply

Please fill out the Google Form below to apply. To show us you read carefully, enter the phrase "Five Clinics Ready" where the form asks for it.

title: Full-Time Outbound Sales Caller / Appointment Setter
description:
Full-Time Outbound Sales Caller / Appointment Setter

Remote | Work From Home | Leaf Doctors

Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Sydney time | 40 hours per week



Leaf Doctors is a fast-growing Australian telehealth clinic seeking a confident, experienced Full-Time Outbound Sales Caller / Appointment Setter to join our Outbound team.



This is a primarily outbound-focused role. Your core responsibility will be calling prospective patients from supplied lead lists – people who have already shown interest in our services – introducing Leaf Doctors, answering their questions, handling basic objections, and converting conversations into booked appointments.



This is not a customer-service, inbound-call, live-chat, patient-management, or social-media role. We are looking for someone who is comfortable spending the majority of their day on the phone, working towards clear daily and weekly call and booking targets.



Key Responsibilities

- Make high-volume outbound calls to supplied lead lists

- Clearly and confidently explain Leaf Doctors' services

- Build rapport with prospects and encourage them to book an appointment

- Follow supplied call scripts and objection-handling frameworks

- Overcome common questions and objections professionally and respectfully

- Accurately update call outcomes, notes, follow-ups and bookings in our CRM

- Follow up on missed calls, call-backs and unbooked leads in a timely way

- Meet daily and weekly outbound call and appointment-booking targets

- Work closely with the Outbound team lead and share feedback on lead quality and common objections



Required Experience & Skills

- Proven outbound calling, telesales, appointment-setting, or lead-conversion experience is essential

- Strong, clear, and confident spoken English

- Comfortable making outbound calls for extended periods each day

- Strong persuasion, rapport-building, and objection-handling skills

- Experience working towards call-volume, conversion, or booking targets

- Experience using a CRM or dialler (GoHighLevel experience is a bonus)

- Accurate and disciplined with notes and data entry

- Reliable internet connection, a quality headset, and a quiet, professional work-from-home environment

- Self-motivated, organised, disciplined, and comfortable working independently



Preferred Experience

- Outbound calling for healthcare, telehealth, clinics or appointment-based businesses

- Calling Australian, US, UK or other English-speaking markets



What Success Looks Like

- Consistently hitting your daily call and booking targets

- Clean, up-to-date notes and outcomes for every lead you call

- Patients who arrive at their appointment informed and ready



Role Details

- Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Sydney, Australia time

- Hours: 40 hours per week

- Location: Fully remote / work from home

- Rate: $7 AUD per hour



Important Application Requirement

A voice recording is mandatory with your application. Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.



Please record a 60–90 second voice clip that:

1. Introduces yourself

2. Describes your previous outbound calling or appointment-setting experience (including typical daily call volumes and booking rates)

3. Includes a short mock opening, as if you were calling a prospective patient who enquired about our services



Start your written application with the words "OUTBOUND CALLER" so we know you've read the full post.



Do not apply unless you have proven outbound calling experience, exceptional spoken English, and are available to work full-time during Sydney business hours.



If you are confident on the phone, experienced in outbound sales, and motivated by booking appointments and achieving targets, we would love to hear from you.

title: Hiring: AI Performance Video Editor & AI Visual Creator (Dropshipping Ecommerce)
description:
Hiring: AI Performance Video Editor & AI Visual Creator



E-commerce | Direct Response Ads | AI Creative Production**



**Open Positions:** Multiple  

**Compensation:** $5–6 USD/hour  

**Type:** Remote | Long-Term  

**Industry:** E-commerce & Dropshipping



About the Role



We are building a high-output creative production team for a multi-product, international e-commerce business.



We are looking for a skilled **AI Video Editor & AI Visual Creator** who can produce high-quality, conversion-focused video and image advertisements efficiently.



You will work on **multiple ad sets, products, and target markets every day.**



Your work will mainly consist of three types of tasks:



1. **Ad Localization:** Translating and adapting existing winning video and image ads into different target languages.

2. **Creative Brief Execution:** Turning detailed creative briefs and visual references into original, professional image ads using AI.

3. **Creative Variations:** Producing new versions of proven advertising concepts for different products, markets, and testing angles.



This is not a basic video clipping or graphic design position. You must understand performance advertising, follow detailed instructions, work independently, and maintain high quality at a fast production pace.



We provide structured SOPs, creative briefs, references, and established AI workflows.



Your Core Responsibilities



1. High-Volume Daily Creative Production



- Work on multiple ad sets and different e-commerce products daily.

- Produce video ads, static image ads, and localized creative variations.

- Handle assignments across multiple markets and languages.

- Work efficiently with established SOPs, AI tools, and templates.

- Maintain consistent quality while meeting daily production expectations.

- Organize files correctly by product, market, batch, and version.



2. Video Ad Localization & Editing



You will receive existing winning video ads and adapt them for new target markets.



Your responsibilities include:



- Analyze the original video and preserve its successful structure, hook, pacing, and storytelling.

- Transcribe and naturally translate the original voiceover.

- Generate localized AI voiceovers using ElevenLabs or similar tools.

- Match the original voiceover's tone, delivery, and pacing.

- Remove, cover, or recreate existing subtitles and text overlays.

- Translate all on-screen captions, hooks, labels, prices, offers, and CTAs.

- Replace competitor branding with the correct product branding.

- Synchronize translated voiceovers, captions, and animated text.

- Preserve important visual elements such as arrows, emojis, graphics, and transitions.

- Ensure all text is properly positioned within platform safe zones.

- Export polished, professional, platform-ready videos.



**Important:** We expect you to handle animated captions, moving text boxes, pop-ups, and complex overlays — not just simple subtitle replacement.



3. Image Ad Localization



You will adapt winning static image ads into other target languages while maintaining the original concept and visual quality.



Your responsibilities include:



- Translate all headlines, subheadlines, CTAs, and embedded text.

- Recreate the original layout, typography, composition, and visual hierarchy.

- Preserve lighting, shadows, perspective, and product realism.

- Replace competitor products, logos, and brand names with our product assets.

- Localize background details such as storefronts, packaging, signs, labels, and receipts.

- Update prices, currencies, discounts, and offers for the target market.

- Use AI image-generation tools to create accurate localized versions.

- Fix AI-generated text errors or visual inconsistencies manually in Photoshop or Canva when necessary.

- Upscale images when needed and deliver sharp, professional results.



**The goal is to keep the proven advertising structure while making the creative look like it was originally produced for the target market.**



4. Creating New Image Ads From Creative Briefs



This is an important part of the position.



You will receive a **structured creative brief**, including product information, advertising direction, reference images, and specific creative instructions.



You must be able to turn this information into a finished, high-quality advertising image.



Our creative brief workflow includes:



Step 1 — Understand the Product & Brief**



Review the supplied creative brief, product funnel, product image, logo, and visual reference (image peg).



Understand the product's positioning, target audience, desired advertising message, and visual direction.



Step 2 — Set Up the AI Workflow**



Use a structured Claude Project with product information, reference assets, and our established prompt templates.



Establish a consistent product color palette and visual identity.



Step 3 — Convert the Brief Into an AI Prompt



Use Claude to transform the creative brief into a detailed prompt for AI image generation.



The generated prompt must follow the brief's visual instructions, target language, product positioning, branding colors, and elements to avoid.



Step 4 — Generate the Creative**



Use tools such as Nano Banana Pro, Higgsfield, or Freepik with the product image, logo when required, and visual reference.



Generate professional advertising visuals that closely follow the creative brief.



**Step 5 — Refine the Output**



Improve and regenerate the creative until it meets the brief.



Check product accuracy, visual realism, layout, branding, text, and overall quality.



Use Photoshop or Canva for manual corrections when AI generation cannot achieve the desired result.



**Step 6 — Final Quality Control**



Check the finished creative against the brief and our production standards before delivery.



You must be comfortable following this entire workflow independently.



### 5. AI Image & Video Production



You should have strong practical experience with AI creative tools.



Expected capabilities include:



- AI product image generation.

- Realistic lifestyle and product advertising scenes.

- Image-to-video and text-to-video generation.

- AI voiceover generation and localization.

- AI-powered text and caption removal.

- Prompt engineering and iterative image refinement.

- Product consistency across multiple creatives.

- Image upscaling and quality enhancement.

- Fixing incorrect AI-generated text, branding, or product details.



We value editors who know how to combine multiple AI tools to solve production challenges efficiently.



### 6. Creative Quality & Accuracy



Every finished creative must meet our quality standards.



You are responsible for ensuring:



- Natural, native-sounding translations rather than word-for-word translations.

- No leftover text from the original language.

- Correct product images, branding, and logos.

- Accurate prices, currencies, offers, and guarantee wording based on provided product information.

- Correct localization of background elements.

- Accurate product appearance and realistic visuals.

- Proper voiceover and subtitle synchronization.

- Consistent captions and professional typography.

- Correct placement of text inside platform safe zones.

- No spelling or grammar errors.

- Compliance with the creative brief and applicable advertising requirements.

- Correct file naming and organization.



## Required Skills



**You must have:**



- Advanced experience producing direct-response e-commerce ads.

- Strong video editing skills using Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or comparable tools.

- Experience creating and editing AI-generated advertising images.

- Ability to reproduce complex text animations and visual overlays.

- Experience localizing video and image ads into different languages.

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, storytelling, product benefits, and conversion-focused advertising.

- Experience working from structured creative briefs and reference images.

- Strong AI prompt engineering abilities.

- Ability to use Claude or similar AI assistants within structured production workflows.

- Basic to advanced Photoshop or Canva skills for manual corrections.

- Ability to produce multiple creatives daily while maintaining quality.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Good English communication and ability to follow written SOPs.



## Preferred AI & Editing Tools



Experience with several of these tools is preferred:



**AI Image Generation**

- Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro

- Higgsfield

- Freepik

- Midjourney

- ChatGPT Images



**AI Video & Voice**

- Kling AI

- Google Veo

- Runway

- ElevenLabs

- HeyGen

- Vmake



**Editing & Creative Production**

- Adobe Premiere Pro

- After Effects

- DaVinci Resolve

- CapCut

- Photoshop

- Canva

- Claude



You do not need experience with every tool, but you must be highly capable with AI-assisted creative production and willing to follow our established workflows.



## What Your Daily Work May Look Like



You will frequently switch between different creative assignments.



**Example 1 — Video Localization**



Take a winning German video ad and create Dutch, Swedish, and Polish versions, including translated voiceovers, captions, hooks, and on-screen graphics.



**Example 2 — Image Localization**



Take an existing winning image ad and recreate it in another language while preserving its layout, composition, and persuasive message.



**Example 3 — New Creative From Brief**



Receive a creative brief, product images, brand assets, and a visual reference. Use Claude and AI image-generation tools to produce professional static image ads that follow the brief.



**Example 4 — Multiple Ad Sets**



Work on several product campaigns in one day, completing a mix of translated creatives, new image ads, and creative variations.



## Who We're Looking For



We want someone who is:



- **Fast:** Comfortable with high-volume production and daily deadlines.

- **Detail-oriented:** Notices small errors in translations, branding, captions, and visuals.

- **Independent:** Can execute assigned tasks without constant supervision.

- **AI-proficient:** Knows how to use AI to improve production speed and quality.

- **Process-driven:** Can follow structured SOPs consistently.

- **Performance-focused:** Understands that these creatives are made to generate sales, not simply look attractive.

- **Adaptable:** Can work across different products, languages, and advertising formats.

- **Reliable:** Communicates clearly and delivers completed work on time.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. **Portfolio:** Examples of e-commerce video ads and static image ads you have created.

2. **Localization Experience:** Examples of ads translated or adapted into another language, ideally including moving captions and voiceovers.

3. **AI Creative Work:** Examples of images or videos you generated using AI.

4. **Tools:** Which editing and AI production tools do you use professionally?

5. **Daily Output:** Approximately how many image ads and video ad variations can you produce during an 8-hour workday?

6. **Availability:** How many hours per week can you work, and when can you start?

7. **Compensation:** Confirm that the $5–6 USD/hour range is acceptable.



**Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete a practical skills test** involving image localization, video localization, or creating an image ad from a creative brief.



---



**Our goal is to build a fast, reliable creative production team capable of transforming winning ad concepts and structured creative briefs into a consistent stream of high-quality, localized, conversion-focused ads.**



If you understand performance advertising, are advanced with AI creative tools, and can deliver excellent work at speed, we want to hear from you.

title: Senior E-commerce Creative Strategist & Ad Researcher (Ecom, Dropshipping, nice benefits, longterm!)
description:
Join a future-focused, AI-driven e-commerce company where exceptional talent is rewarded with competitive compensation, long-term career growth, real ownership, and the opportunity for top performers to earn profit-sharing — because we believe the people who help build extraordinary results should share in the success.

E-commerce | Dropshipping | Direct Response Advertising | Competitor Research | Creative Strategy



Open Positions: 1\

Compensation: $6–9 USD/hour\

Type: Remote | Long-Term\

Industry: E-commerce, Dropshipping & Performance Marketing\

Focus: Winning Ad Research, Competitor Intelligence, Creative Angles, Ad Concepts & Testing Strategy



## About the Role



We are building a high-performance creative operation for an international, multi-product e-commerce and dropshipping business.



We are looking for an experienced E-commerce Creative Strategist & Ad Researcher who deeply understands direct-response advertising, dropshipping funnels, winning ad formats, customer psychology, and performance-driven creative testing.



This is a senior-level strategic position.



You will be responsible for finding winning advertising concepts, analyzing competitor strategies, researching customer desires and pain points, and developing creative directions that our production team can turn into high-converting advertisements.



Our business launches and tests multiple products across different countries and languages. You must be able to research different product categories quickly, identify proven advertising mechanisms, and build structured creative strategies for each product.



We are not looking for someone who simply collects competitor ads or suggests generic marketing ideas.



We need someone who understands why advertisements work, how they sell, and how to turn research into a repeatable pipeline of winning creatives.



You will work closely with our creative brief builders, AI video editors, and image creators.



## Your Core Responsibilities



### 1. Advanced Competitor & Winning Ad Research



A major part of your daily work will involve researching successful e-commerce and dropshipping advertisements.



Your responsibilities include:



- Research competitor advertisements across Meta,
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Google, and Pinterest.

- Identify promising, validated, and potentially scalable ad concepts.

- Analyze competitor products, positioning, creative strategies, pricing, offers, and sales funnels.

- Study different advertising styles, structures, hooks, and messaging approaches.

- Investigate competitor landing pages, product pages, advertorials, VSLs, and checkout funnels.

- Identify recurring creative patterns across successful advertisers.

- Distinguish potentially winning ad concepts from generic or visually attractive advertisements.

- Research source markets and identify concepts that could work in additional countries.

- Organize findings into structured, actionable research documents.



The goal is to identify commercially valuable advertising opportunities, not simply create collections of advertisements.



### 2. Deep Understanding of E-commerce Ad Formats



You must have strong knowledge of the different creative formats used in performance-driven e-commerce advertising.



These include:



- UGC (User-Generated Content) advertisements

- Testimonial and customer story ads

- Product demonstration ads

- Problem–Agitation–Solution ads

- Before-and-after creatives

- Advertorial-style advertisements

- VSL and long-form direct-response video

- Storytelling and emotional narrative ads

- Founder-style and authority-led ads

- Educational and explanation-based ads

- Comparison and competitor-alternative ads

- Review and social-proof advertisements

- Curiosity-driven and pattern-interrupt hooks

- Native-looking social media advertisements

- Static image advertisements

- Product-focused image ads

- Benefit-driven and problem-focused creatives

- Comparison charts and infographic-style ads

- AI-generated UGC and AI visual advertisements



You must understand when and why each format works, which audiences it is suitable for, and how it fits into the customer journey.



### 3. Customer Psychology & Market Research



You will research the psychology behind purchasing decisions for different products and markets.



Your responsibilities include:



- Identify the target customer's biggest problems, frustrations, fears, and objections.

- Research desired outcomes, emotional motivations, and purchase triggers.

- Understand customer awareness levels and market sophistication.

- Analyze customer language, reviews, questions, and recurring complaints.

- Identify the strongest product benefits and advertising angles.

- Research competitor promises, unique selling propositions, and positioning.

- Find gaps in competitor messaging that could become new creative opportunities.

- Understand how emotional and rational buying motivations differ between audiences.

- Convert customer insights into persuasive, product-specific advertising concepts.



You should understand direct-response principles such as customer awareness, offer architecture, perceived value, proof, credibility, urgency, objection handling, and conversion mechanisms.



We expect strategic thinking based on customer evidence, not assumptions.



### 4. Creative Angles, Hooks & Advertising Concepts



You will turn research into clear advertising strategies for our products.



Your responsibilities include:



- Develop multiple creative angles for individual products.

- Identify strong hooks and opening concepts based on customer psychology.

- Create advertising concepts around different desires, pain points, product benefits, and objections.

- Recommend the most suitable ad formats for each angle.

- Analyze existing winning ads and identify the psychological mechanisms worth adapting.

- Develop new approaches inspired by validated advertising concepts.

- Recommend visual directions, proof elements, storytelling structures, and CTA approaches.

- Differentiate between cold-audience prospecting, consideration-stage, and retargeting creatives.

- Prioritize concepts based on commercial potential, available evidence, and testing value.



You must be capable of turning a single product into a structured backlog of distinct advertising angles and concepts.



### 5. Creative Strategy for Multiple Products & Markets



Our business operates across multiple products, niches, countries, and languages.



You will need to:



- Research several product categories and launches in parallel.

- Quickly understand unfamiliar product niches.

- Identify relevant winning concepts from other markets and product categories.

- Recommend which existing ad concepts should be adapted to new products.

- Research cultural differences and local purchasing behavior.

- Identify how hooks, offers, claims, visuals, and messaging should change for different countries.

- Provide market-specific creative recommendations.

- Preserve proven advertising mechanisms while adapting concepts to local audiences.

- Consider local language, currency, market expectations, pricing, and consumer objections.



You are responsible for giving our creative team the strategic direction necessary to produce relevant ads for different target markets.



### 6. Creative Brief Strategy & Production Handoffs



You will work closely with senior creative editors and ad brief builders.



Your role is to provide the research, commercial thinking, and creative direction behind their production briefs.



You will:



- Select strong reference ads and explain why they are worth testing.

- Identify the core advertising mechanism behind each reference.

- Define the target customer, primary pain point, desired transformation, and main sales angle.

- Recommend hooks, concepts, proof elements, and ad formats.

- Specify which elements of a winning reference should be preserved.

- Explain which elements should change for our product or target market.

- Provide supporting customer research and competitor examples.

- Suggest script directions, opening scenes, and key messaging.

- Define clear hypotheses for creative variations.

- Communicate product facts, claim limitations, and important localization considerations.



Our senior brief builders will translate your research into detailed production instructions for the AI video and image editors.



Your responsibility is to make sure they have strong, commercially relevant creative direction rather than generic ideas.



### 7. Creative Testing Strategy & Iteration



We continuously test different products, angles, hooks, and advertising concepts.



You will help build a structured testing pipeline.



Your responsibilities include:



- Create and prioritize creative testing hypotheses.

- Recommend different hooks, visual openings, angles, and formats.

- Develop testing variations based on specific audience motivations.

- Distinguish meaningful creative tests from cosmetic changes.

- Identify which concepts deserve additional variations.

- Review available performance data and creative feedback.

- Analyze why certain ads perform better than others.

- Identify patterns in successful and unsuccessful creatives.

- Recommend new iterations based on performance learnings.

- Maintain an organized backlog of creative opportunities.



You should understand relevant performance metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPM, CPA, conversion rate, ROAS, thumb-stop rate, hold rate, and creative fatigue.



You do not need to manage advertising campaigns, but you must understand how creative decisions influence advertising performance.



### 8. AI-Assisted Research & Strategic Workflows



We use AI extensively to accelerate research, organize information, and support creative production.



You should be comfortable using tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI-assisted research platforms.



Expected capabilities include:



- Working with structured Claude Projects or equivalent research environments.

- Organizing product research, competitor insights, and advertising references.

- Using AI to analyze large amounts of customer and competitor information.

- Generating and refining creative angle hypotheses.

- Developing structured creative strategy documents.

- Extracting useful advertising patterns from research.

- Maintaining repeatable research templates and workflows.

- Verifying AI-generated insights against reliable sources.

- Clearly separating validated findings from untested hypotheses.



AI should improve the speed and quality of your strategic work, not replace critical thinking.



### 9. Research Organization & Documentation



You will help maintain a structured creative intelligence system.



Your responsibilities include:



- Organize competitor references by product, category, market, format, and advertising angle.

- Maintain libraries of successful hooks and creative concepts.

- Document customer research, objections, desires, and purchase motivations.

- Keep research easy to understand and useful for the production team.

- Maintain source references and clear explanations for recommendations.

- Prepare concise research summaries and strategic updates.

- Ensure creative insights can be reused for future products and launches.

- Communicate blockers and missing information proactively.



We value clear, actionable documentation over lengthy reports with little commercial value.



## Required Skills & Experience



You must have:



- Proven hands-on experience with e-commerce or dropshipping advertising.

- Strong background in direct-response marketing and conversion-focused creative strategy.

- Deep understanding of
 and Instagram advertising creatives.

- Strong familiarity with TikTok advertising and creative research.

- Experience researching winning competitor advertisements.

- Understanding of one-product stores, dropshipping offers, product funnels, and advertorials.

- Familiarity with different video and static image ad formats.

- Strong understanding of customer psychology, hooks, emotional triggers, storytelling, and offers.

- Ability to identify and explain why an advertising concept may convert.

- Experience developing creative angles and concepts for performance campaigns.

- Ability to research unfamiliar product categories quickly.

- Strong understanding of creative testing and iteration.

- Experience with Meta Ad Library and other advertising research platforms.

- Ability to turn research into clear, practical instructions for creative production teams.

- Strong English writing and communication skills.

- Excellent organization and ability to handle multiple products simultaneously.

- Experience using AI research and workflow tools.

- Ability to work independently, follow SOPs, and take ownership of deliverables.



You should be able to show real examples of your strategic work, not just talk about marketing theory.



## Preferred Tools & Platforms



Experience with several of the following is preferred.



Ad Research & Competitor Intelligence:



- Meta Ad Library

- TikTok Creative Center

- Google Ads Transparency Center

- Pinterest advertising research

- Similarweb

- Minea

- Pipiads

- Foreplay

- AdSpy

- Dropshipping product and competitor research tools



AI & Research:



- Claude / Claude Projects

- ChatGPT

- AI-assisted research and analysis tools

- Google Sheets

- Google Docs

- Structured research databases and creative libraries



Performance & Funnel Research:



- Meta Ads Manager reporting

- Shopify stores and product pages

- Advertorial funnels

- Direct-response landing pages

- VSL and long-form sales funnels

- Competitor funnel analysis



You do not need to know every platform, but you must already have an effective research process and understand how to identify valuable advertising opportunities.



## What Your Daily Work May Look Like



Example 1 — Research a New Product



Receive information about a newly selected dropshipping product.



Research competitors, customer problems, purchasing motivations, existing ads, funnels, and market positioning.



Identify the strongest advertising angles and recommend the first concepts to test.



Example 2 — Find Winning Advertising Concepts



Research competitors and relevant product categories to identify promising ad structures.



Break down the hook, emotional driver, proof, offer, and conversion mechanism.



Explain how the concept could be adapted to one of our products.



Example 3 — Develop a Creative Testing Roadmap



For an upcoming product launch, develop multiple distinct advertising angles.



Recommend formats, hooks, audience motivations, and testing priorities.



Provide your findings to the creative brief builders so they can prepare production-ready ad sets.



Example 4 — Market Expansion



Research how an existing successful advertising concept could be adapted from one country to another.



Identify differences in customer language, objections, cultural references, offers, and advertising expectations.



Provide localization recommendations to the production team.



Example 5 — Performance-Based Iteration



Review the results of recently tested ads.



Identify which hooks, angles, or formats show the strongest potential.



Recommend the next creative tests and explain the reasoning behind them.



## Expected Deliverables



You will be expected to consistently deliver:



- Product-specific competitor and customer research.

- Structured breakdowns of promising advertising concepts.

- Prioritized creative angles and hook recommendations.

- Clear creative strategy direction for upcoming product launches.

- Market-specific advertising and localization insights.

- Actionable research handoffs for senior creative brief builders.

- Organized reference libraries and research documentation.

- Regular competitor and market insight updates.

- Creative testing recommendations supported by evidence.

- Iteration plans informed by available campaign results.



Your success will be evaluated based on the usefulness, quality, speed, and commercial relevance of your research and recommendations.



The goal is not to produce the largest number of ideas. It is to consistently identify strong, testable concepts that help the creative team produce better advertisements.



## Who We're Looking For



We want someone who:



- Thinks like an experienced direct-response marketer.

- Understands the fast-paced e-commerce and dropshipping industry.

- Can recognize commercially promising advertising concepts.

- Has excellent analytical and customer research skills.

- Understands how different creative formats influence conversions.

- Can explain the reasoning behind creative recommendations.

- Is highly organized and works efficiently.

- Is comfortable researching multiple products and markets every day.

- Has strong judgment and does not blindly trust AI-generated findings.

- Is proactive, independent, and solution-oriented.

- Can communicate clear strategic direction to editors and creative producers.

- Understands that the objective is profitable customer acquisition, not simply producing attractive advertisements.



We want a strategist who can think commercially, research deeply, and move quickly.



## How to Apply



Please include the following:



1. Your experience: Describe your background in e-commerce, dropshipping, direct-response advertising, and creative strategy.

2. Previous work: Provide examples of competitor research, creative strategies, ad concepts, or creative briefs you have developed.

3. Winning campaigns: Share examples of advertising concepts you researched or developed that performed well, including measurable results if available.

4. Research process: Explain how you identify promising competitor ads and determine which concepts are worth testing.

5. Creative expertise: Which advertising formats and e-commerce funnels do you have the most experience with?

6. Tools: Which competitor research, ad intelligence, and AI tools do you use regularly?

7. Daily capacity: How many products can you realistically research and develop initial creative strategies for in an 8-hour workday?

8. Availability: Confirm your working hours, time zone, weekly availability, and earliest start date.

9. Compensation: Confirm that the $6–9 USD/hour range is acceptable.



## Practical Skills Assessment



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a paid research and creative strategy assessment.



You will receive one e-commerce product and relevant product information.



The assignment will involve:



- Identifying three meaningful competitor or customer insights.

- Developing three differentiated advertising angles.

- Creating five strong advertising hooks.

- Recommending appropriate ad formats.

- Preparing a prioritized creative testing plan.

- Explaining the reasoning behind your recommendations.



We will evaluate your research quality, direct-response knowledge, commercial judgment, clarity, and ability to provide actionable direction for a creative team.



---



We are looking for an experienced creative strategist who knows how to find winning advertising opportunities, understand customer psychology, develop compelling creative concepts, and build repeatable testing strategies.



This is an opportunity to take ownership of the research and strategic direction behind a fast-moving international e-commerce creative operation.



If you understand dropshipping, direct-response advertising, winning ad research, and how to turn customer insights into high-converting creative concepts, we want to hear from you.

description:

, direct networking) to initiate contact with potential partners and manage incoming inquiries.

* Research & Lead Generation Skills: Strong track record in online research, web sourcing, and targeted outreach to senior decision-makers.

* Football Ecosystem Literacy: Clear understanding of how professional clubs, academies, agencies, scouting networks, and transfer windows operate.

* Professional Communication: Excellent written English with a polished, authentic tone capable of building immediate trust with high-profile industry figures.

* Analytical Mindset: Skilled at mapping organizational hierarchies, unearthing hard-to-find contact details, and identifying ideal partner fits.

* Organized & Self-Directed: Highly structured with the ability to manage multi-channel research and outreach pipelines independently.



CORE OBJECTIVE

Research and identify prospective football partners, initiate professional outreach, and secure qualified partner alignment calls for our team.

title: E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS ASSISTANT
description:
IMPORTANT NOTICE TO APPLICANTS

Attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions are part of our screening process. Each step is clearly outlined, so please read carefully and complete all requirements.

Incomplete applications or those that fail to follow instructions will not be considered.





E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS ASSISTANT

MORALVE | JOB DESCRIPTION

Department: E-commerce Operations | Reports To: Operations & Supply Chain Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time | Work Arrangement: Remote



POSITION OVERVIEW

MORALVE is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, resourceful, and proactive E-commerce Operations Assistant to support the daily operations of our growing e-commerce business.



This versatile, hands-on role covers marketplace and account health monitoring, inventory tracking, customer service, logistics coordination, data entry, administrative support, and ongoing system and database maintenance.



The primary purpose is to ensure daily operations run smoothly, information remains accurate and current, and recurring tasks are monitored, documented, and completed. The assistant works closely with the Operations & Supply Chain Manager across Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.



We value reliability, initiative, follow-through, adaptability, and willingness to learn as much as previous technical experience. As familiarity develops, the role can progress from task execution toward independent ownership of routine workflows, exception identification, and project coordination.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Marketplace Account Monitoring & Maintenance

• Perform daily and recurring checks across Amazon and other assigned marketplaces.

• Monitor account health, notifications, alerts, warnings, and pending action items.



2. Inventory Monitoring & Maintenance

• Monitor inventory availability and stock health across marketplaces and inventory systems.

• Track replenishments, transfers, inbound activity, and receiving updates.

• Update inventory trackers and compare internal data against marketplace records.



3. Customer Service & Customer Experience Support

• Monitor and respond to routine customer inquiries using established guidelines and templates.

• Support order inquiries, delivery concerns, returns, refunds, and replacements within approved authority.

• Track unresolved cases, document actions, and follow up to closure.

• Identify recurring product or service issues and escalate sensitive or nonstandard cases.



4. Logistics, Shipment & Order Monitoring

• Monitor shipment and logistics updates, communications, and operational notifications.

• Maintain shipment trackers and milestones, including estimated arrival, delivery, and receiving.

• Assist with Amazon FBA, AWD, and other marketplace inbound monitoring.

• Record shipment references and organize supporting documents.

• Follow up on missing routine updates and flag delays or discrepancies.



5. Purchase Order & Supplier Coordination Support

• Maintain purchase order records, production updates, and related tracking systems.

• Monitor supplier communications, completion dates, inspection updates, and outstanding information.

• Collect quotations, documents, and routine supplier information.



6. Data Entry, Database & Tracker Maintenance

• Perform accurate recurring data entry and maintenance in spreadsheets, trackers, and databases.

• Update records using verified
s, reports, marketplace information, and supplier communications.

• Identify duplicate, missing, outdated, or inconsistent data.

• Assist with historical backtracking, cleanup, cross-checking, and reconciliation.

• Follow established data standards, formatting, and naming conventions.



7.
, Communication & Task Management

• Monitor assigned operational inboxes and channels; categorize and label communications.

• Identify and execute routine actions, follow-ups, documentation, and escalation.

• Track outstanding requests and pending responses.

• Communicate updates to internal and external stakeholders as appropriate.



8. Document & File Organization

• Download, rename, categorize, and store operational files according to company standards.

• Organize product, shipment, purchase order, inspection, supplier, and customer service documents.

• Support historical file cleanup and ensure records are traceable to their transactions.



9. Routine Operational & Administrative Support

• Complete assigned daily, weekly, and monthly checklists and maintenance tasks.

• Assist with account checks, reporting, data collection, research, and administrative activities.

• Support routine coordination across departments and evolving business needs.



10. Project Coordination & Process Improvement

• Maintain assigned project boards, task lists, deadlines, and documentation.

• Track deliverables, follow up on action items, and report blockers early.

• Assist with small operational projects and SOP documentation.

• Suggest practical improvements to accuracy, organization, and efficiency.



QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Experience in at least 3 areas: : e-commerce operations, virtual assistance, administrative support, customer service, marketplace management, inventory/order management, logistics support, or data entry.

• Working knowledge of Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel, including basic formulas, sorting, filtering, and organizing data.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, written and verbal English communication.

• Ability to interpret
s, spreadsheets, reports, and operational systems and determine routine next steps.

• Ability to manage recurring responsibilities, follow SOPs, and work independently in a remote environment.

• Reliability, accountability, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn.



Preferred

• Experience with Amazon Seller Central or similar platforms.

• Familiarity with marketplace account health, listings, inventory, orders, and e-commerce customer service.

• Experience with Google Workspace and project tools such as 
, ClickUp, Asana, or Notion.

• Basic familiarity with Amazon FBA/AWD, shipments, purchase orders, and replenishment.

• Experience working with suppliers or logistics providers and maintaining SOPs or operational trackers.



KEY COMPETENCIES

Attention to Detail - Maintains accurate records and recognizes inconsistencies.

Reliability & Consistency - Completes recurring responsibilities on time.

Ownership & Accountability - Takes responsibility and follows tasks to completion.

Proactiveness - Identifies missing information, pending actions, and potential issues.

Problem-Solving - Investigates and proposes possible solutions before escalation.

Learning Agility - Learns new tools and processes quickly.

Organization & Prioritization - Distinguishes urgent issues from routine tasks.

Communication & Follow-Through - Provides timely updates and closes loops.

Adaptability - Supports changing needs across operational functions.

Process Discipline & Judgment - Follows SOPs and recognizes when approval is required.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

• Complete daily, weekly, and monthly responsibilities accurately and on time.

• Keep operational records complete, consistent, and up to date.

• Identify and report marketplace, inventory, customer service, and logistics issues promptly.

• Track open inquiries and action items through resolution.

• Communicate progress, challenges, and blockers proactively.

• Gradually manage assigned recurring workflows with less supervision.



WORK SCHEDULE & BENEFITS

Work Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Work Arrangement: Remote

13th Month Pay: Provided annually

Paid Holidays: Paid Philippine Regular and Special Non-Working Holidays

Paid Time Off (PTO): 5 paid leave days per year

Team Environment: Collaborative and supportive remote team

Professional Growth: Hands-on exposure to e-commerce tools and operations



GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES

Initially, the role focuses on learning MORALVE's systems, completing recurring tasks accurately, and maintaining reliable records. With demonstrated consistency, accountability, and judgment, the assistant may progress toward independent ownership of operational processes, advanced marketplace and inventory responsibilities, reporting and reconciliation, workflow improvement, and cross-functional project coordination.





If these resonate with you, we’d love to hear from you!

Ready to apply?

Click (or copy the link to your browser) below to get started:

Apply Here 👉 Initial Applicant Form : 



Our application process includes a few steps to help us get to know you better, including some initial questions, online assessments, and a short video introduction.

We recommend setting aside enough time to complete everything in one go. Please read the instructions carefully and make sure all required information is submitted.



Having trouble accessing the form? Feel free to
 us at 
 and we'll be happy to assist.



Thank you for your interest in joining MORALVE! We appreciate the time and effort you're putting into your application and look forward to learning more about you.

title: Full-Cycle Recruiter (US Home Cleaning Company) - Full Time, Long Term
description:
PAY

US$600 a month to start, raised to US$675 at 6 months with a good review, plus a bonus for every hire still working with us at 90 days.



SCHEDULE

Full time, Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern time, including a one-hour lunch break.



ABOUT US

TotalCare Cleaning is a growing home cleaning company in the United States. Our cleaners are independent professionals, and our office team works remotely from the Philippines.



THE JOB

You own every hire from their first contact to their 90th day. Your goal: every cleaner and every virtual assistant you hire is still with us at 90 days, with no customer complaints.



HIRING OUR CLEANERS

- Contact every new applicant within 1 working hour, review our AI phone screens, and keep every applicant moving with calls and texts.

- Run the face-to-face video interview on Google Meet, score it on our scorecard, and d
 who moves forward.

- Collect and check the required documents, hand off to the background check, and check in with the applicant every 2 business days while it runs.

- Run the live orientation on Google Meet: the training slides, the standards quiz, the signed Standards Acknowledgment, and setting up our cleaner app.

- Own every new cleaner through her first 5 jobs: a check-in call after each job, calls on day 30, 60 and 90, and answering her texts through day 90.



HIRING OUR VIRTUAL ASSISTANTS

- Run the full hiring process: invite candidates, verify their computer and internet setup, check references, interview on video with our scorecard (English included), and prepare the offer letter.

- Get each new VA ready for day 1 and check in with them through day 90.



EVERY DAY

- Work your task list in our system, overdue items first, and keep every candidate's record accurate the same day.



HOW WE MEASURE YOU

- Cleaner seats filled within 14 days.

- More than 70% of your hires still with us at 90 days, and more than 85% with no customer complaints.



WHAT YOU NEED

- At least 1 year of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally hiring US hourly or gig workers.

- Excellent spoken and written English. You will call, text, interview and train US applicants every day.

- Confident running video interviews and live trainings on Google Meet.

- Organized, reliable, and great at follow-up without being chased.

- Spanish is a strong plus.

- A reliable computer, internet of at least 50 Mbps down and 20 Mbps up, and a backup connection.



HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume and a short voice recording (1 to 2 minutes) telling us about the best hire you ever made and why. Applications without the voice recording will not be reviewed.

title: Business Development Assistant
description:
ABOUT THIS ROLE

We're looking for a highly motivated and multi-talented Virtual Assistant to join our growing group homes business on a part-time basis. You'll be the driving force behind our business development, marketing, and operational initiatives—helping us scale our capacity and reach the right clients. This is a hands-on role where you'll wear multiple hats and help us build systems from the ground up.



IMPORTANT: Since this role involves phone outreach, we require all applicants to submit a short voice recording (1-2 minutes) along with their application so we can hear how you communicate over the phone. Instructions are included in the "How to Apply" section below.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Business Development & Lead Generation



Conduct cold calling campaigns to identify and engage potential referral sources

Send outreach
s to build relationships with key stakeholders and referral partners

Use Apollo to research and scrape domain/contact information for targeted outreach

Create and implement a follow-up system to nurture leads through the sales pipeline

Track and report on lead generation metrics and conversion rates



Marketing & Content Creation



Develop a cohesive brand kit in Canva (including logos, color palettes, fonts, templates)

Design and create marketing flyers, social media graphics, and promotional content

Manage our
 Business Page (posting, engagement, community management)

Manage our LinkedIn page (posting industry insights, updates, engagement)

Develop social media strategy to attract our target audience (group home operators, families, referral partners)

Create engaging content that drives engagement and attracts referral sources



Website & Digital Presence



Implement strategies to improve website SEO and increase organic traffic

Monitor click-through rates and traffic metrics

Collaborate on optimizing website content for lead generation

Manage digital files and ensure proper organization of all web assets



Documentation & Administrative Systems



Manage digital files and organize onboarding documentation

Upload and create documents in JotForm, Adobe, and/or DocuSign

Develop standardized templates for common documents

Help establish and organize file management systems

Assist with creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) as systems are being developed



Operational Support



Be flexible and adaptable—we're still building out our systems, so you'll work collaboratively as we establish processes

Help identify inefficiencies and suggest solutions

Contribute ideas for improving workflows and operations

Support the owner in any additional tasks needed to fill beds and grow the business



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



Proven experience as a Virtual Assistant or in a similar business development/marketing role

Strong communication skills - both written and verbal

Experience with cold calling and
 outreach (B2B or business development background preferred)

Proficiency in: Canva, social media management platforms, Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, document management systems, Apollo (or willingness to learn), JotForm, Adobe, or DocuSign

Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

Self-motivated and comfortable working independently

Problem-solving mindset - able to work in a developing environment and help create solutions

Familiarity with
 Business Manager and 
 is a plus

Basic SEO knowledge or willingness to learn



IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE



Detail-oriented and organized

Proactive and solution-focused

Comfortable with technology and quick to learn new tools

Energetic and enthusiastic about supporting business growth

Able to prioritize and manage deadlines in a fast-paced environment

Experience in healthcare, social services, or related fields is a plus

Eager to grow with a scaling business and take ownership of projects



WORK ENVIRONMENT



Fully Remote - work from anywhere in the Philippines

Growing Company - we're actively building out our systems and processes

Collaborative - you'll work closely with the business owner to develop solutions

Flexible - you'll need to adapt as we establish new processes and SOPs

Impactful - your work directly contributes to helping families access quality group home services



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

This isn't a position where everything is perfectly structured—and that's the opportunity! We're looking for someone who:



Thrives in dynamic environments

Can help us build scalable, organized systems

Takes initiative and doesn't wait to be told what to do

Provides feedback and ideas for improvement

Is energized by the challenge of building a business from the ground up



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



Time Zone: This position requires working on Eastern Standard Time (EST) hours — no exceptions. Please only apply if you are able to commit to working EST hours consistently.

Schedule: 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM EST, Monday-Friday (part-time, 20 hrs/week)

Starting Pay: $4.00/hour (part-time)

Commission: $50 per successful onboarding — earned for each person you help move into a home

Pay Schedule: Weekly, paid via Remitly

Probationary Period: 90 days. Upon successful completion (meeting deadlines, quality of work, and reliability), your hourly rate will increase.

Growth Potential: This is a starting rate with room to grow as you prove yourself and take on more responsibility.



TOOLS & SYSTEMS YOU'LL USE



Phone System: Quo

Payments: Remitly

Design: Canva

Lead Generation: Apollo

Documents: JotForm, Adobe, DocuSign

Social Media:
 Business Page, LinkedIn



HOW TO APPLY

Please submit:



Your resume/CV

A brief cover letter explaining why you're interested in this role

A short voice recording (1-2 minutes) introducing yourself — tell us about your experience and why you'd be a great fit. This helps us hear how you communicate over the phone.





EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of background.

Ready to help us grow? We'd love to hear from you!

Contact research tools and a calling platform.



Covered business calling costs.
